jobs.title: Product Manager – Growth & Innovation (all genders) - 100% Home Office
jobs.description:
Gestalte die digitale Zukunft mit fino digital!

fino hat seine Wurzeln im ersten digitalen und vollautomatisierten Kontowechsel der FinTech-Branche. Seit der Gründung im Jahr 2015 hat sich fino stetig weiterentwickelt und ist heute der marktführende Innovationstreiber in den Bereichen Konto- und Datenanalyse, Regulatorik, Steuern und Dokumentenmanagement. Mit maßgeschneiderten Lösungen schafft fino für seine Kunden und Partner neue Perspektiven für Geschäftsmodelle im B2B- und B2B2C-Bereich.

Wir bei fino digital sind überzeugt, dass datengetriebenen Geschäftsmodellen die Zukunft gehört. Unsere Mission ist es, Daten einen Wert zu geben und sie durch intelligente Data-Analytics-Lösungen in hochwertige Insights zu verwandeln. Mit über 240 Millionen durchgeführten Transaktionsanalysen und Kooperationen mit mehr als 1.000 Banken sowie 10.000 weiteren Partnern, darunter renommierte Namen wie Sparkassen, VR-Banken, DATEV und Schufa, genießen wir das Vertrauen zahlreicher Unternehmen und Institutionen.

Möchtest du Teil dieses innovativen Teams werden und die digitale Zukunft aktiv mitgestalten? Dann bewirb dich jetzt bei fino digital!

Deine Aufgaben

  • Du verantwortest die Produktvision und Roadmap für unsere Kontowechsel-Produkte und entwickelst diese kontinuierlich weiter – von neuen Features bis hin zu ganz neuen Produktkonzepten
  • Du spürst Chancen für neue Use Cases und europaweite Märkte auf, bringst eigene Ideen ein und treibst sie mit Überzeugung bis zur Umsetzung voran
  • Du priorisierst dein Backlog klar und datenbasiert und sorgst dafür, dass dein Team genau an den Themen arbeitet, die den größten Wachstum schaffen
  • Du übersetzt die Bedürfnisse unserer Kunden und Partner im europäischen Markt in konkrete, umsetzbare Produktanforderungen
  • Du arbeitest eng mit unserem Managing Director Banking als Sparringspartner zusammen und entwickelst gemeinsam die Produktausrichtung weiter
  • Du misst den Erfolg deiner Entscheidungen an klaren Kennzahlen und leitest daraus die nächsten Schritte ab

Deine Qualifikationen

  • Du bringst mehrjährige Berufserfahrung als Growth Manager, Product Owner oder Produktmanager (all genders) mit, idealerweise im FinTech- oder Banking-Umfeld
  • Du denkst unternehmerisch, hast ein starkes Gespür für datengetriebene Produkte und triffst Entscheidungen auf Basis von Zahlen und echten Nutzerbedürfnissen
  • Du bringst eine ausgeprägte Hands-on-Mentalität mit, übernimmst Verantwortung und bringst deine Themen eigenständig ins Ziel
  • Du bringst idealerweise bereits Erfahrung in internationalen bzw. europäischen Märkten mit und hast Freude daran, Produkte auch über Ländergrenzen hinweg zu denken
  • Du kommunizierst klar und überzeugend gegenüber dem Team ebenso wie gegenüber Kunden und der Geschäftsführung
  • Du sprichst Deutsch und Englisch verhandlungssicher und bringst angesichts unserer weiteren europaweiten Ausrichtung idealerweise weitere Fremdsprachenkenntnisse mit

Unsere Benefits

  • Gestaltungsspielraum: Viel Eigenverantwortung, offene Kommunikation, aktive Mitgestaltung und ein motiviertes, erfolgsorientiertes Team
  • Flexibles Arbeiten: Remote-first mit hybriden Optionen, flexible Arbeitszeiten, modernes Equipment, Workation
  • Tech & Innovation: Moderner Tech-Stack und KI-Kultur
  • Attraktive Zusatzleistungen: Jahresbonus, Geschenke zu Jubiläen und runden Geburtstagen, Corporate Benefits, vergünstigte Handytarife, übergesetzliche Zuschüsse zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge, Vermögenswirksame Leistungen
  • Gesundheit & Mobilität: Jobticket, Bikeleasing, vergünstigte Fitness- & Wellnessangebote in deiner Stadt (egym)

jobs.title: Product Manager (f/m/d)
jobs.description:
adjoe builds the technologies behind mobile apps growth and monetization. adjoe Ads is our programmatic in-app advertising platform that seamlessly connects advertisers and publishers through direct integration of our Android and iOS SDKs. Every ad decision happens in under 200ms across 10 million daily users, powered by real-time bidding algorithms and user quality prediction models that match the right ad to the right user at the right moment.

Your Mission & Who We Are Looking For:

  • Programmatic AdTech Domain Expertise: 3–4 years of Product Management experience (with at least 3 years directly in Programmatic, Ad Exchange, SSP, or DSP environments) to lead our DSP-facing ad exchange capabilities across their full lifecycle. You thrive when dissecting OpenRTB specs, auction mechanics, and mobile formats (video, playable, native, display) to turn programmatic complexities into clear product roadmaps.

  • Technical Infrastructure & API Fluency: Hands-on comfort working alongside senior engineers to parse system architecture, API designs, JSON data payloads, and latency tracking. You will bridge technical execution with business strategy across a platform running 20+ Go microservices on Kubernetes and Kafka, orchestrating 1,500 bid requests per second.

  • Auction Mechanics & Traffic Shaping: Deep analytical capability to optimize win rates, timeout rates, bid density, and Supply Path Optimization (SPO). You will design smart throttling and routing logic that reduces infrastructure QPS costs while maximizing revenue across 120M processed auctions daily.

  • Cross-Functional Partner Integration: Direct technical collaboration with the Demand Partnerships team and external partners to lead DSP onboardings and maintain OpenRTB compliance. You act as the translation layer between client feedback, external demand needs, and detailed Product Requirements Documents (PRDs).

  • Data-Driven Metric Ownership: Relentless focus on defining and monitoring core performance indicators including fill rate, bid rate, CPM, and eCPM. You will partner with data teams to analyze complex data sets, troubleshoot technical issues, and measure feature performance alongside ML models making 50 billion daily predictions.

  • Agile Product Delivery: Proven track record of owning end-to-end execution, experimentation, and scaling in an Agile environment. You manage multi-stakeholder dependencies cleanly and ship high-throughput features iteratively without sacrificing low-latency requirements.

🌎 We welcome applications from talent worldwide and provide relocation support to Hamburg, Germany for those ready to join our team.

What’s in It for You?

At adjoe, you’re not here to just close JIRA tickets, you’re helping build the infrastructure behind one of the most impactful platforms in adtech. The systems you work on will reach hundreds of millions of users and power billions of decisions every day.

  • Go Big. Own projects with impact on 770M users and push adtech boundaries.

  • Move Fast. Ship solutions multiple times a day, learn from results, and keep momentum.

  • Be Direct. Solve problems openly and collaborate across teams.

  • Thrive Together. Grow with a diverse, global team of people from over 40 different countries that learn from each other.

  • Have Fun. Celebrate wins, enjoy daily victories, and bring your energy.

Our mission is to create an inspiring work environment for amazing people to achieve extraordinary things. Be part of it!

Skip writing cover letters. Tell us about your most passionate personal project, your desired salary, and your earliest possible start date. We are looking forward to your application!

We welcome applications from people who will contribute to the diversity of our company.

Following our recent $80m Series C funding, we are ready to push beyond.

We are looking for a Lead Product Manager to join our Demand Product team. In this key role, you'll shape the core infrastructure that powers Distribusion's entire marketplace — the API and platform capabilities that sit at the heart of our customer success strategy. Your focus will be on driving the reliability, scalability, and quality of our platform, ensuring it maintains the highest functional standards across all scenarios, while developing strategic initiatives that future-proof our technology and enable growth at a global scale.

What you will do:

Who you are:

  • User-Driven Mindset: You can translate metrics, user behaviour, and needs into business values and detailed product requirements, including technical specifications.

What you can expect:

jobs.title: Product Manager – Platform Experience & Cloud Administration (m/f/d)
jobs.description:
What is Jedox?

Jedox is a leading provider of Enterprise Performance Management (EPM) solutions, helping organizations plan, analyze, and drive business performance with confidence. More than 2,000 companies worldwide, from ambitious mid-sized businesses to global enterprises, rely on Jedox to streamline planning, budgeting, forecasting, and reporting processes.
Recognized as a leader in the Gartner® Magic Quadrant™, Jedox combines powerful planning capabilities with a modern cloud platform that enables businesses to adapt quickly and make informed decisions. At Jedox, we believe in innovation, impactful results, people centricity, and the power of #OneTeam to help our customers succeed.


Your Responsibilities

As Product Manager – Platform Experience & Cloud Administration, you will own the strategy, roadmap, and delivery of key platform experiences including navigation, onboarding, user access, and cloud administration. Working closely with Engineering, Design, and Architecture, you will drive improvements that enhance usability, customer trust, and platform scalability, helping shape how thousands of users experience Jedox every day.

What You'll Do

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap: Define and drive the product vision, roadmap, and priorities for Platform Navigation, BaseUI, and Cloud Console capabilities.
  • Lead discovery and product validation: Conduct user research, gather stakeholder input, analyze customer needs, and validate opportunities to ensure impactful product investments.
  • Shape the platform experience: Improve navigation, onboarding, login experiences, session management, and integrations with platform services such as analytics and feature flagging solutions.
  • Drive Cloud Console evolution: Enhance the self-service administration experience, enabling IT teams to efficiently manage environments, users, permissions, and access controls.
  • Manage end-to-end product delivery: Guide initiatives from concept through delivery, launch, and communication while ensuring high-quality execution and measurable outcomes.
  • Prioritize and make trade-offs: Balance customer needs, technical complexity, business priorities, and long-term platform goals to make informed product decisions.
  • Partner with Engineering and Architecture: Collaborate closely with technical leaders to align short-term delivery with sustainable platform architecture and scalability.
  • Enable cross-functional alignment: Work with Product, Design, Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and Leadership teams to build shared understanding and drive successful execution.
  • Monitor product success: Define key outcomes, measure adoption and user experience improvements, and continuously optimize platform capabilities.
  • Champion customer-centric innovation: Ensure platform experiences support both end users and IT administrators while strengthening customer trust and satisfaction.
What Success Looks Like in Your First Year
  • Administrators can complete common configuration and management tasks independently without requiring support tickets.
  • Time-to-value for new users is significantly reduced through enhanced onboarding and navigation experiences.
  • A clear, credible multi-year platform roadmap is established and supported by Engineering, Sales, and Leadership stakeholders.


Your Profile

  • 3–5 years of experience as a Product Manager within enterprise SaaS environments.
  • Experience owning and developing foundational product areas such as platform services, administrative experiences, developer portals, or similar infrastructure-related products.
  • Strong understanding of the needs of both IT buyers/administrators and end users.
  • Proven ability to define product strategy, prioritize initiatives, and drive execution in complex, cross-functional environments.
  • Ability to build trust with engineering teams through clear problem definition, structured thinking, and pragmatic decision-making.
  • Experience navigating dependencies across multiple teams and stakeholders.
  • Comfortable working in ambiguous environments and turning complexity into actionable plans.
  • Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills.
  • Fluent English communication skills, both written and verbal.

___________________________________________________________________________

DEXIOS ist unsere Cloud-Plattform für Zutrittskontrolle, Zutrittsmanagement und Zeiterfassung. Die Software ist live, sie ist noch jung, und sie steht jetzt an dem Punkt, an dem aus einem funktionierenden Produkt eine skalierbare SaaS-Lösung wird.
Du übernimmst die Produktverantwortung für diesen Weg: Du entscheidest, was gebaut wird, in welcher Reihenfolge und warum. Du arbeitest nah an der Entwicklung, am Backlog in GitHub und an Architekturdiskussionen, und du verantwortest die Roadmap gegenüber Geschäftsführung, Vertrieb, Marketing, Projektgruppe und Support.
In dieser Rolle hast du viel Gestaltungsspielraum: Wenn du die nächsten Jahre lieber ein Produkt von innen prägen willst als ein fertiges zu verwalten - lies weiter!


Deine Aufgaben

PRODUKT – Roadmap und Priorisierung

  • Du verantwortest die DEXIOS-Roadmap und entscheidest laufend, welche Themen jetzt zählen und welche warten
  • Du priorisierst gegen Nutzen, Aufwand und Marktchance und kannst deine Entscheidungen gegenüber Geschäftsführung, Vertrieb und Kunden vertreten
  • Du schneidest Anforderungen so, dass sie umsetzbar sind: User Stories, Akzeptanzkriterien, sinnvolle Releasegrößen
  • Du pflegst das Backlog in GitHub und arbeitest im Sprint-Rhythmus direkt mit dem Entwicklungsteam
TECHNIK – Architektur und Systemlogik
  • Du verstehst, wie DEXIOS funktioniert: Mandantenfähigkeit, Rollen- und Rechtemodelle, Berechtigungslogiken, IAM-Anbindung über OAuth 2.0 / OpenID Connect, Konnektoren zu Entra ID, SAP und HR-Systemen
  • Du diskutierst mit Entwicklung und SW- Architektur auf Augenhöhe über Machbarkeit, Abhängigkeiten und technische Schulden und hast Spaß daran den Prozess proaktiv zu moderieren, um eine Lösung zu finden
  • Code schreiben gehört nicht dazu - aber die Logik hinter dem System interessiert dich, und du kennst sie gut genug, so dass deine Priorisierung trägt
UX – wie Menschen mit DEXIOS (und zukünftig mit KI) arbeiten
  • Du hast eine Haltung dazu, wie sich Frontends durch KI verändern: Was bleibt Klickpfad, was wird Dialog, was läuft automatisch im Hintergrund?
  • Du trägst zur positiven User Experience bei: Wie kommen Sicherheitsverantwortliche, HR-Mitarbeitende oder der Werkschutz mit dem System zurecht, heute und in drei Jahren?
  • Die Designgrundlagen von DEXIOS stehen. Du arbeitest damit, entwickelst sie weiter und machst die Vorgaben für User Flows bis hin zu Bedienlogiken
KI – in der Rolle und im Produkt
  • Du nutzt KI in deiner täglichen Arbeit: Prototypen, User Stories, Analysen, Backlog-Aufbereitung, Kundenfeedback verdichten
  • Du baust Prototypen selbst, statt auf Kapazität zu warten. Ein klickbarer Prototyp in zwei Stunden bringt uns weiter als ein theoretisches Konzept in zwei Wochen
  • Du bringst deine Perspektive ein, wo KI im Produkt echten Nutzen schafft und wo sie nur Aufsatz wäre
TEAM – Schnittstellen
  • Du gehst proaktiv auf Kollegen zu, schaffst regelmäßigen Dialog und sorgst dafür, dass Anforderungen, Prioritäten und Entscheidungen für alle Stakeholder nachvollziehbar sind
  • Du holst Feedback von Kunden sowie aus Support-Anfragen und übersetzt diese in Produktentscheidungen
  • Du bist bei Kundenterminen dabei, wenn es hilft, und regelmäßig vor Ort in München, weil gute Entscheidungen meist im Gespräch entstehen
PROFIL – Dein Kompetenzset 
  • Du hast mehrjährige Erfahrung als Product Owner oder technischer Produktmanager (m/w/d) für ein Softwareprodukt, davon mindestens zwei Jahre mit echtem Ownership – du hast das Software- oder SaaS-Produkt verantwortet und durch relevante Reifephasen geführt.

  • KI ist Teil deiner Arbeitsweise, nicht ein Punkt auf deiner Skill-Liste. Du kannst konkret erzählen, wofür du sie zuletzt eingesetzt hast, und auch, wann sie dich falsch beraten hat
  • Du kommunizierst und verhandelst sicher auf Deutsch und Englisch und hast ein Bewusstsein für Informationssicherheit (ISO 27001)
Was diese Rolle nicht ist
  • Kein Ticket-Schreiben nach fremder Vorgabe. Die Roadmap kommt von dir
  • Keine reine Strategie-Rolle mit Folien. Du arbeitest im Sprint mit
  • Kein Scrum-Master-Job. Prozesspflege ist nicht der Kern
  • Kein fertiges Produkt mit fertigen Prozessen. Vieles bauen wir gerade erst auf, das ist Freiheit und Arbeit zugleich


Das bieten wir

  • Produktverantwortung mit Mandat. Kurze Wege, direkte Berichtslinie an die Leitung der Business Unit, Entscheidungen ohne Gremienmarathon
  • Eines der spannendsten Themen im Markt: Zutrittsmanagement wandert in die Cloud, und PCS gestaltet diesen Wandel mit einem eigenen Produkt statt mit Zukäufen
  • KI-Werkzeuge, die du wirklich nutzen darfst. Lizenzen, Zeit zum Ausprobieren und ein Umfeld, das KI-gestütztes Arbeiten erwartet statt duldet

jobs.title: Product Manager - AI Stockbroking App
jobs.description:
About KIRA

Our mission is to make money smart, reliable and within reach for everyone.

 

In 2019, we built the first mobile-first, insurance platform, enabling insurance to be accessible online by millions in the region. Today, it's the leading insurance platform in Southeast Asia.

 

Today, we are expanding ways to help people in Asia and it includes spending, saving, investing, exchanging, travelling, and more. Our objective is to build tools that will help people get more from their money and at ease and self reliance, become an expert. We believe AI will help us achieve this in our generation.

We are looking for the most talented and driven people we can find. We are looking for people who work for their passion, not counting hours. Who loves building great next-generation products, not status quo. Who cares about redefining how everyone around us can get the best financial applications, not for an exclusive few.

We have teams working around the world, with over 20 nationalities and growing from our offices and remotely. Join us and build a better future.

If you're this person, we'd love to talk to you.

 

The Role

We are looking for product managers to own product areas within KIRA's AI Stockbroking App.

This role is for builders who can understand users, define product direction, work with engineering and design, launch fast and keep improving after release.

 

What You'll Own

  • Own product areas across insurance, payments, savings, investing, travel or other financial services.

  • Define user problems, product scope, success metrics, roadmap and launch plans.

  • Work with engineering, design, data, operations, compliance and business teams.

  • Turn complex financial products into simple, usable customer journeys.

  • Use data, feedback, research and production issues to improve product decisions.

  • Launch features, monitor performance and drive iterations.

  • Make trade-offs between speed, user experience, business impact, compliance and operational complexity.

 

What We're Looking For

  • Experience as Product Manager, Product Owner, founder, growth/product operator or similar role.

  • Strong product sense and ability to simplify complex workflows.

  • Able to work with engineers and designers to ship real products.

  • Comfortable with metrics, user feedback, experiments and post-launch learning.

  • Strong writing, prioritization and stakeholder management.

  • High ownership and ability to drive work with limited guidance.

  • Experience in fintech, insurance, payments, consumer apps or high-growth products is a strong advantage.

 

The Kind of Builder We Want

  • Starts from user problems, not feature lists.

  • Can make decisions with incomplete information.

  • Knows how to ship quickly and learn after launch.

  • Works well with engineering without hiding behind process.

  • Honest about what changed because of their work versus wider team effort.

 

This Role Is Not For

  • People who only write decks and do not drive execution.

  • PMs who cannot work deeply with engineering.

  • Candidates who need perfect data before making decisions.

  • People who launch features and then stop caring.

  • PMs who exaggerate business impact without understanding attribution.

 

Location

This role is remote, but candidates must be based in Germany. We are hiring specifically for this market, so applicants should already be based in Germany.

 

Language

English is our main working language across global teams. Strong English communication is required.

 

Interview Process

Our process is designed to move fast:

1. Online assessment or practical task

2. Role-specific interview

3. CEO / final round

 

For strong candidates, we aim to complete the process and make an offer within 1 week from the start of the interview process. Candidates who complete assessments quickly will be prioritized.

jobs.title: Senior Product Manager, KYB - MoonPay Enterprise
jobs.description:
MoonPay Enterprise is for builders with something to prove.

This isn't a "work on cool crypto stuff" company. It's a high-standards, high-velocity, high-accountability company building the operating system for value movement. If the internet moves information, we move value: crypto, stablecoins, tokenized assets, and whatever comes next. Four offerings make that real: fund, tokenize, trade, and spend.

MoonPay Enterprise is the fund layer built for businesses. We power how stablecoins move through real financial operations: enterprises, fintechs, PSPs, wallets, and marketplaces running their treasuries, their cross-border flows, and their stablecoin operations on us. The goal is to make moving real money at scale as predictable as any other piece of financial infrastructure, with the compliance and controls CFOs need to say yes.

AI is the default operating mode here. It's woven into every role, and we expect you to use it daily. It handles the manual work so you can deliver on what actually matters.

You'll thrive here if outcomes excite you more than process, if impact motivates you more than titles, and if you want hard problems, real ownership, and teammates who love winning, building, and doing it together.

The bar is high. The pace is real. We're building the rails that businesses run real money on, for humans and agents. MoonPay ranked #2 in Crypto Services on Fortune's inaugural Crypto 100, made Forbes' America's Best Startup Employers 2026 (Top 25 in Finance), and landed on The Sunday Times Best Places to Work two years running.


About MoonPay Enterprise

MoonPay Enterprise is one of the more operationally complex products in the stablecoin space: multiple banking providers, multiple payment rails, a growing partner base across two product lines (Orchestration and Issuance), and an active compliance surface across each. MoonPay Enterprise runs B2B, B2B2B, and B2B2C models. Partners integrate our API. Their customers become direct customers of MoonPay Enterprise for compliance purposes.

KYB is the front door. Every partner is a business. Every business customer of every partner clears KYB before a single transaction moves. Today the flow is part automated registry verification, part manual review, with different rules for the US and the rest of the world, and turnaround measured in days. That does not scale to where MoonPay Enterprise is going. KYB has to become a product: measurable, fast, API-first, defensible in front of regulators and banking partners. This is a principal seat. You set the multi-year direction for how businesses enter MoonPay Enterprise, and you own the outcome.

What You'll Own

KYB product strategy & roadmap

  • Business onboarding end-to-end, across every model MoonPay Enterprise runs: partners onboarding onto MoonPay Enterprise, businesses onboarding directly, and business customers onboarding through partners.

  • Platform altitude. KYB decisions ripple into KYC, Travel Rule capture, banking-provider onboarding, and Issuance partner diligence. Connect the surfaces; don't optimise one in isolation.

  • MoonPay Enterprise runs three KYC delivery models (reliance, outsourcing, hosted). KYB coverage is uneven across them. You decide where it expands and in what order.

  • Genuine product depth on MoonPay Enterprise is non-negotiable. Within weeks you talk fluently about KYB outcomes, UBO requirements, virtual account structures, and API behaviour. From being hands-on, not from documentation.

Onboarding funnel & conversion

  • The KYB funnel is yours: pass rate, time-to-verified against a 48-72h target, manual review rate, drop-off per step.

  • Instrument what isn't instrumented. Make approval speed and rejection quality measurable. Then move both.

  • Fix rejection UX. Today a declined business often gets a status without a reason, and the partner escalates to support to find out what is missing. Rejection reasons, retry semantics, and resubmission flows become API surface partners build on.

KYB API & partner experience

  • The KYB API surface: statuses, webhooks, document submission, and the edge cases that make business onboarding hard (sole proprietors, corporate shareholders, one person who is UBO, Director, and Representative at once).

  • Partners integrate KYB in weeks and self-serve their onboarding questions. Every "what is missing for this customer" escalation is a product gap. Close it.

Compliance as product

  • Turn compliance-approved onboarding matrices into product logic. US and non-US differ: control prong versus directors, when ownership documents are required, self-certification options. Partners should never need to read a matrix.

  • EDD triggers, high-risk classification, prohibited industries, Travel Rule capture: you decide how they show up in the product.

  • Compliance is your sparring partner, not a ticket queue. You shape how policy becomes product. They own the policy.

Vendor & provider orchestration

  • The verification stack (SumSub today) and the build-versus-buy calls around it.

  • Cost per verification, automation rate, vendor performance. Know when a second provider, a waterfall, or in-house tooling earns its place.

  • Push automation. Decide where AI-assisted review with a human in the loop replaces manual queues, and prove it does not raise risk.

  • Every new banking provider brings its own onboarding requirements. Keep KYB compatible with every rail without collecting everything from everyone.

Who You Are

  • A principal-level PM with real KYB or KYC depth. You have owned onboarding, identity, verification, or risk as a platform, not a feature.

  • High agency. You do not wait for a mandate, a brief, or perfect data. You find the problem, claim it, and fix it.

  • Full autonomy, zero to one. Hand you an unowned surface and you take it from first principles to shipped. No handover document, no waiting for direction.

  • AI-fluent by default. AI tools are your daily instruments for analysis, prototyping, and drafting. You run your own queries; analysis is not something you request from another team.

  • Compliance is a design constraint, not a blocker. You read a requirements matrix and see API design, funnel steps, and copy.

  • You know your funnel cold: pass rate, time-to-verified, manual review rate, cost per verification.

  • At home in API-first B2B. Your users are partner engineers and the businesses behind them, not consumers.

  • You have run verification vendors (SumSub, Persona, or equivalents) and know when to switch, stack, or build.

  • A multiplier for the product team around you. You raise the bar for how compliance-heavy product work gets scoped, specced, and shipped.

  • Bias to action. Reactive stewardship of an existing flow is not what we are hiring for.

 
NYC Salary: $217,000 - $279,000

Research has shown that women are less likely than men to apply for this role if they do not have experience in 100% of these areas. Please know that this list is indicative, and that we would still love to hear from you even if you feel that you are only a 75% match. Skills can be learned, diversity cannot.

Benefits & Perks 💡

  • 💰 Competitive salary package

  • 🤝 Equity package: financial freedom starts with our employees, so all employees have ownership at MoonPay

  • 📈 Pay-for-performance equity bonus: those who drive outsized outcomes receive outsized rewards

  • 🚀 Moonshot award: we honor exceptional impact. 10 employees twice a year, each earning a $250,000 equity grant

  • 📊Pension: employer contributions from day one

  • 🎁Employee referral program: refer great people, earn 10K in USDC

  • 🏝 Flexible Time Off: choose when to work and when to switch off

  • 🎂 Birthday leave: take the day off to celebrate you

  • 🍼 Enhanced parental leave: more time with family, no second thought

  • 🌍 Hybrid working schedule: work fully remotely or from your nearest Moonbase

  • 🚆 Commuter benefits: public transport to and from the office

  • 🩺 Private healthcare benefits: to protect you and your loved ones

  • 🧘 Wellhub wellness membership: access to gyms, studios, classes, and wellness apps in one membership

  • 🤖 Unlimited enterprise access to the latest AI tools: Claude, ChatGPT, Gemini and whatever's next

  • 🍱 Lunch credit: meals covered on the days you're in the office

  • 🪑 Home office setup allowance: build the home office of your dreams

  • 👛 Remote working allowance: those working fully remotely get a little extra for utilities

  • 🌕 Monthly product budget and zero-fee crypto transactions

  • 📚 $1,000 Annual training budget: we support your learning journey

  • 🎯 High Potential Program: structured development, mentorship, and stretch opportunities

  • ✈️ Regular remote company offsites: high-impact in-person sessions and hackathons

  • 🚲 (Ireland) Cycle to Work scheme: tax-efficient bike, gear, and safety kit

  • 🔌 (UK) EV Salary Sacrifice: lease an electric vehicle through pre-tax salary

 

Commitment to Diversity

At MoonPay we believe that every voice matters. We strive to create a mindful and respectful environment where everyone can bring their authentic self to work, and experience a culture that is free of harassment, racism, and discrimination. That's why we are committed to diversity and inclusion in the workplace and are a proud equal opportunity employer. We prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by law. This policy applies to all employment practices within our organization, including, but not limited to, hiring, recruiting, promotion, termination, layoff, and leave of absence.

MoonPay is also committed to providing reasonable accommodations in our job application procedures for qualified individuals with disabilities. Please inform our Talent Team if you need any assistance completing any forms or to otherwise participate in the application process.

Launch your product career at Europe's leading music education platform

Matchspace Music is Europe's leading music education platform. We help thousands of music teachers build sustainable careers from teaching, and we are scaling fast across international markets. You will work directly with our VP Product.

This is a role for someone hungry. You want to see how a product is discovered, specified, built, shipped, measured and improved, and you want to be hands-on across the whole cycle. Everything we build follows one cycle: build, measure, learn, repeat. We are looking for a sharp analytical mind that is also creative in solving problems and providing fresh insights. In return you get a front-row seat in building AI-powered platforms, an AI-first way of working, and high visibility to the leadership team as we grow internationally.

Tasks

  • Feature conceptualization. Turn evidence into product ideas. You will run the full loop, from insight, to concept and options, to a sprint-ready story, and back to the data to see whether it worked.
  • Requirements engineering. Turn customer insights and support feedback into clear, buildable user stories with business context, acceptance criteria and edge cases. Own the qualification funnel so nothing rots and no ticket enters a sprint under-specified.
  • Sprint operations. Run backlog hygiene, standup and review mechanics, dependency flags and blocker tracking with our development team, so decisions get made once and stay made.
  • UAT, QA and testing. Own regression and release testing. Reproduce defects properly, keep the bug board honest, and support UAT and end-to-end dry runs.
  • Analytics and performance measurement. Own recurring KPI reporting across our tool stack, close measurement gaps, and turn funnel and cohort data into insight the team acts on. Every feature we ship is measured against the question: did it work? What was the impact?

Requirements

  • A relevant degree in business engineering, IT, information systems, digital business administration, or a related field, whether ongoing or recently completed.
  • Analytical and creative. You enjoy digging into data to find the real problem, and you are creative about how to solve it. Build-measure-learn is how you already think.
  • Structured and detail oriented. You find clean documentation and reproducible analysis satisfying, not tedious.
  • Comfortable with data. Excel/Sheets at a solid level, able to read dashboards, willing to learn fast
  • Comfortable and confident with software development technicalities, with viewing software code and understanding code with the help of AI
  • Proficient in German (min. B2) and English (C1). You can write a requirement someone else can build from. Your main operating language is English. German is essential for our Swiss home market.
  • Already using AI tools in your daily productivity workflow and genuinely curious about how software gets built.
  • Self-managing in a fast-moving, distributed team.

Nice to have

Agile/Scrum exposure, ticket systems, manual QA or test-case experience, and an interest in music, education or marketplaces.

Benefits

  • Work directly with the VP Product in a dynamic, cross-functional team spanning Product, Marketing and Customer Success.
  • Full end-to-end exposure: discovery, requirements, delivery, release, measurement and growth.
  • A front-row seat at Europe's leading music education platform, with real breadth across very different product challenges.
  • A modern, AI-first working culture.
  • A high-visibility talent role with direct exposure to the leadership team and an attractive international career trajectory as we scale.

We run a short, structured screening built around real examples of your work and how you think. Tell us who you are, why this role, and when you can start. We will take it from there.

jobs.description:
About ScholarshipOwl

ScholarshipOwl is the largest scholarship marketplace in the US, using AI to connect 14 million students who are looking for scholarships with companies that are looking for students. Our mission is to make education financing more accessible and engaging, while giving brands a way to connect with the next generation.

We’re powered by AI technology that simplifies scholarship discovery, streamlines the application process, and delivers measurable results for both students and partners. Whether it’s helping students secure funding or enabling brands to run impactful campaigns, we’re reshaping how education is funded — and discovered.


The Role

We’re looking for a highly skilled and innovative Senior Full-Stack Engineer to architect high-performance web applications and accelerate our development velocity across our B2B platform. You’ll play a pivotal role in bridging modern Nuxt 3/4 frontend applications—including customer management portals and embeddable widget engines—with a robust Laravel and Doctrine ORM backend API, delivering seamless experiences that connect millions of students to funding opportunities.

You will own the technical implementation of core products across our entire stack, working with PHP 8.2+, Laravel, MySQL, and Vue 3 / Nuxt 3/4. Beyond traditional engineering, this role champions efficiency: you will deeply integrate AI-native workflows (using tools like Cursor and Google Gemini) to double shipping velocity, automate test coverage, and build intelligent LLM-driven platform features. If you are passionate about full-stack architecture, widget infrastructure, and leveraging AI to build smarter and faster, this role is for you.


What You’ll Do

  • Full Lifecycle Development: Architect, build, and ship end-to-end B2B features across the stack- from Laravel/Doctrine JSON:API endpoints to reactive Nuxt 3/4 Vue components and server routes.

  • Embed & Analytics Engine: Develop and optimize high-performance embedded widget systems, Nitro server engine logic, iframe cross-origin messaging, client event-tracking SDKs, and data ingestion pipelines.

  • API & Database Architecture: Design robust relational database schemas (MySQL), Doctrine entity mappings, clean migrations, performant RESTful/JSON:API contracts, and Redis caching layers.

  • AI-Native Acceleration: Integrate AI coding tools (Cursor, Gemini) into daily development for rapid feature prototyping, code refactoring, test generation, and building LLM-driven product features (e.g., automated applicant evaluation).

  • Third-Party Integrations*:* Integrate and maintain core third-party services and APIs, including CRM platforms, error tracking systems, payment gateways, and cloud data services

  • Automated Testing & Quality: Establish comprehensive automated test coverage (PHPUnit for backend, Playwright and Vitest for E2E/components) integrated into CI/CD pipelines to guarantee zero regressions.

  • Mentorship & Code Reviews: Conduct thorough, constructive code reviews and collaborate closely with product managers, QA engineers, and leadership to elevate team standards.


Required Qualifications (Must Haves)

  • Experience: 4+ years of professional full-stack web development experience, with at least 1+ year actively incorporating AI coding assistants into daily engineering workflows.

  • Backend Expertise (PHP & Laravel): Strong commercial experience with PHP 8+ and Laravel (clean service architecture, queues/jobs, middleware, and OAuth2/Passport authentication).

  • Frontend Mastery (Vue 3 & Nuxt 3/4): Deep proficiency in modern Vue 3 (Composition API), Nuxt 3 or Nuxt 4, TypeScript, Pinia state management, and Tailwind CSS.

  • Database & ORM Skills: Strong relational database modeling and query optimization in MySQL, along with solid experience using ORMs (Doctrine ORM / DBAL or deep Eloquent experience with the ability to adapt to Doctrine quickly).

  • API Design & Caching: Deep understanding of RESTful / JSON:API standards, server-side validation error mapping, request formatting, and Redis performance caching.

  • AI-Native Workflow: Active daily use of AI coding tools (Cursor, Gemini) as a force multiplier for coding, debugging, and test creation.

  • Automated Testing: Hands-on experience writing backend test suites (PHPUnit) and frontend/E2E tests (Playwright, Vitest, or Cypress).

  • DevOps & Tooling: Solid working knowledge of Git, CI/CD release pipelines, Docker containerization, and Linux/container environments.

  • Async Communication & Autonomy: Exceptional written technical communication skills for authoring PRs, architectural design docs, and issue tracking; high autonomy to navigate multi-service codebases, solve complex blockers independently, and drive initiatives.

Good to Have

  • Education & Background: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Software Engineering, or equivalent practical software engineering experience.

  • Certifications*:* Advanced degree or formal certifications in Cloud Architecture, Modern Software Engineering, or AI Engineering.

  • Doctrine ORM: Direct production experience with Doctrine ORM / DBAL in Laravel environments.

  • Widget & SDK Systems: Experience developing embeddable web widgets, lightweight JavaScript tracking SDKs, iframe cross-origin communication, or browser fingerprinting.

  • Modern Tooling: Experience with Nitro server engines, Bun runtime, PrimeVue components, or streaming data into data warehouses (e.g., BigQuery).

  • Payment Gateways: Integration experience with payment processors (Stripe/Braintree) and B2B subscription billing lifecycles.

  • Gemini LLM Integration: Practical experience integrating Google Gemini models (prompt engineering, structured JSON outputs, Gemini API / SDKs).

  • Cloud Infrastructure (GCP): Hands-on experience with Google Cloud Platform (Cloud Run, Kubernetes, Cloud Build).

    Bonus Skills (The "X-Factor")

    • Technical Leadership: Prior experience in a Tech Lead or Team Lead capacity—driving architectural decisions, coordinating delivery, and unblocking team members.

    • Domain Knowledge: Background in high-growth B2B SaaS platforms, grant/applicant management systems, EdTech, recruitment/ATS tools, or conversion tracking ecosystems.

    • Product-Minded Execution: Strong product ownership mindset—evaluating engineering trade-offs through the lens of user experience, conversion funnel impact, and tangible business value.

jobs.title: Product Manager, Homepage
jobs.description:
About Wolt

At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we're building the delivery of (almost) everything and you'll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.

Working at Wolt isn't always easy, but it's definitely exciting. Here you'll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You'll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you're a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.

Join us in shaping the experience that millions of customers land on every time they open DoorDash, Wolt, or Deliveroo. As part of our Core Consumer organisation, our Homepage team owns one of the single biggest levers we have on what customers find and one of the hardest surfaces in the app to get right.

Working at the intersection of ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML, you'll help decide what each customer sees and why, across three brands and dozens of markets. You'll be building on a global stack, and your roadmap will be a mix: global platform problems that apply worldwide, global capabilities we're accelerating into EMEA, and EMEA-specific problems worth solving properly rather than working around.

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join our Homepage team. In this role, you'll shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes and products — and help define what discovery looks like as AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way people decide what to order.

What You'll Be Doing

You'll be joining a team working on one of the most-used surfaces in the app.

Here's what your day-to-day might look like:

  • Building new end-to-end features and user experiences on Homepage that shape how customers discover restaurants, grocery and retail venues, dishes, and products.
  • Working on ranking, personalisation, and AI/ML problems in the Homepage domain, including how we decide what each customer sees and why.
  • Exploring where AI-driven and agentic experiences change the way customers discover what to order.
  • Making discovery work across three brands and many markets, without flattening into one-size-fits-all.

What You'll Need to Thrive

Our ideal candidate will bring strong product judgment and curiosity to grow into the rest:

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager on consumer-facing products - discovery, homepage, feed, or ranking-driven experiences are especially relevant.
  • You are a product manager more than a feature owner. Someone who finds the customer problems that matter most and makes the case for solving them.
  • You work backwards from the customer problem, and weigh it against what the business needs most right now.
  • You're comfortable holding several business objectives at once and making a call when they pull in different directions.
  • You work well with a wide range of stakeholders and build trust with people whose priorities differ from your own.
  • You think strategically and can move between long-term direction and what we should ship next.
  • You're comfortable with ambiguity and genuinely flexible (this industry is changing fast, AI most of all).
  • You're curious about what AI actually changes for customers, and can tell real value from hype.

Next steps

The position will be filled as soon as we find the right person, so make sure to apply as soon as you realize you really, really want to join us!

Our Commitment to Diversity and Inclusion

We're committed to growing and empowering a more inclusive community within our company, industry, and cities. That's why we hire and cultivate diverse teams of people from all backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe that true innovation happens when everyone has room at the table and the tools, resources, and opportunity to excel.

jobs.description:
1KOMMA5°

At 1KOMMA5°, we pursue a clear vision: Living on wind and sunlight forever for free. To make this a reality, we are building the energy system of the future with Heartbeat AI. Want to be part of it?

We bring together regional craftsmanship and scalable software: We don't think of solar, batteries, heat pumps, and e-mobility as isolated components, but control them as an intelligent, integrated overall system in our virtual power plant. Directly connected to the electricity market – in real time, fully automated. This way, energy is used when it is available from renewables and particularly cost-effective. By 2030, our goal is to transition 1.5 million households to renewable energies. Over 3,000 people are working towards this every day, at more than 80 locations worldwide, from Finland to Australia.

Want to take responsibility and build solutions that truly matter? Apply now and help us shape the energy world of tomorrow.

Learn more about our Product & Tech team!


Your mission

As the (Senior / Staff) IT Operations Specialist, you will be the assigned Tech counterpart for the holding/central employees at 1KOMMA5.  This means that every 1KOMMA5 employee in the holding will know their Tech Business Partner by name, and have trust to include them in all technical discussions that improve their productivity. You are accountable for the holdings success.

The average day of a (Senior / Staff) IT Operations SpecialistThe role is divided into 3 key value areas

  1. Tech Support on level 1, 2  and 3 tickets created by holding employees. The goal here is to be familiar with stakeholders for faster, more efficient turnaround.  Tickets are not escalated, but are triaged and discussed to improve technical understanding and develop.  You will also monitor queues for the other markets for urgent out of hours requests, and action them when necessary. Level 1 and 2 tickets may be delegated to working students in the team, with guidance and accountability. 

  2. Tech Projects - This refers to projects imposed by Employee Technology Platform product strategy such as rollout of Chrome OS and tool consolidations for the holding. This also refers to inbound projects imposed by holding teams (e.g. tailor onboarding experience, setup n8n flows).

  3. Tech Consulting - Providing solutions using existing tools first, through enablement sessions. If no solutions exist, working with teams to technically own and benchmark new applications.  There is a particular push to enable AI usage to boost productivity. This means any queries on how to use basic or advanced AI toolings would be directed to this role.


Your profile

  • Minimum of 10+ years of proven professional experience in IT systems, systems engineering or a related field

  • Experience with IT support ticketing best practices, and analysis

  • Proven ability to lead a small and assertive team

  • Proven ability to work both independently, and as part of a team on Technology related projects

  • Profound knowledge of Google Workspace, Office 365, Mobile Device Management (JAMF and InTune) and other SaaS applications (Zoho CRM is a huge plus) surrounding employee productivity, collaboration and security

  • Profound knowledge of AI tooling, specifically relating to employee productivity

  • Understanding on how to utilize scripting to build bespoke functions. Experience with web-front end HTML, CSS,  AppScript, Python and Cursor AI

  • Understanding of the workings of cloud infrastructure and code deployment practices and discipline is a huge plus

  • Generalist knowledge of office infrastructure (e.g. office WLAN)

  • Comprehensive knowledge and proven disciplinary action of domain management

  • Strong people skills, being able to persuade and consult non-technical stakeholders on technical solutions

  • Ability to demonstrate design thinking methodology

  • Ability to collaborate in a fast-paced, agile environment and adapt to changing priorities while maintaining a security focus

  • Relevant IT Bachelors or Masters degree - certifications related to MTD, MAM are a plus

  • German and English written and verbal communication

  • Willingness to travel primarily to 1KOMMA5 the other holding locations (Munich & Hamburg)


Benefits

  • You are part of an international, dynamic, and highly motivated team of people who have proven to make things happen
  • With your work, you accelerate the "energy transition" and hence have a direct impact on our climate
  • Work with and learn from other super-smart colleagues

  • You will enjoy the best chances of entering full-time in one of Europe’s most thriving scaleups

jobs.description:
About Mistral

Mistral provides full-stack AI solutions: from frontier models to developer tools, applications, and compute. We partner with enterprises tackling the hardest problems—across high-stakes industries like finance, manufacturing, defense, healthcare, and the public sector—co-creating customized AI systems that they can run on their terms.

We are a dynamic, collaborative team passionate about AI and its potential to transform society. Our diverse workforce thrives in competitive environments and is committed to driving innovation. Our teams are distributed between Europe, North America, Asia and the Middle East. We are creative, low-ego and team-spirited.

The Role

 

As Staff AI Deployment Strategist, you will shape how some of the most ambitious enterprises in the UK & Nordics region adopt frontier AI at scale.

This is a senior, high-impact role at the intersection of strategy, technology, and execution. You will work directly on Mistral’s most strategic opportunities and largest deliveries, helping customers move from ambition to measurable business outcomes. You will frame complex AI transformation programs, turn executive priorities into actionable roadmaps, and ensure that Mistral delivers systems that are valuable, scalable, and trusted.

You will also act as a senior sponsor on our most critical customer programs, bringing judgment, structure, and delivery excellence to high-stakes engagements. Your mandate is to raise the ambition and quality of AI adoption: helping customers identify where AI can create step-change value, making the right trade-offs, and ensuring that execution matches the strategic promise.

This role is ideal for an experienced strategy consultant, transformation leader, or senior operator who wants to move from advising on change to building it directly with frontier AI technology.

 

What You Will Do

  • Shape high-impact AI transformations

    • Partner closely with Mistral’s Sales leadership in the UK & Nordics to qualify opportunities, align on account strategy, and drive executive engagement.

    • Work with senior customer stakeholders to identify where frontier AI can create material business value.

    • Structure complex opportunities into clear, credible, and executable transformation programs.

    • Translate strategic ambition into delivery roadmaps, success metrics, and operating plans.

    • Help customers make the right trade-offs between ambition, feasibility, speed, and long-term scalability.

  • Sponsor Mistral’s most strategic deliveries

    • Act as a senior sponsor on the largest and most complex customer programs, primarily in the UK & Nordics and potentially cross-region as priorities evolve.

    • Ensure delivery quality, executive alignment, and measurable business impact.

    • Anticipate risks, unblock decisions, and help teams navigate ambiguity in high-stakes environments.

    • Bring senior judgment to moments where scope, resources, timelines, or expected value need to be clarified.

  • Build repeatable deployment excellence

    • Turn lessons from strategic engagements into reusable approaches, playbooks, and patterns.

    • Raise the bar for how AI programs are qualified, framed, delivered, and scaled.

    • Act as a senior relay for the Solutions organization in the region, helping teams adopt shared best practices, adapt them thoughtfully to local market specificities when needed, and strengthen the quality of execution.

    • Work hand in hand with Solutions leadership to connect customer realities, delivery patterns, and field feedback into practical ways of improving how Mistral deploys AI.

    • Help codify what great enterprise AI deployment looks like across industries and use cases.

    • Contribute to a Solutions culture that combines strategic clarity, technical depth, and strong execution.

  • Develop and multiply senior DS impact

    • Coach Deployment Strategists on strategic problem-solving, executive communication, and delivery leadership.

    • Help teams raise the quality of their work on the highest-impact opportunities.

    • Identify capability gaps and contribute to hiring, staffing, and development priorities.

    • Act as a force multiplier across accounts, teams, and regions where your experience can have the highest leverage.

 
 

What We're Looking For

 

You are a senior, highly capable professional with strong executive presence, excellent business judgment, and a track record of leading complex strategic or transformation work.

Typical indicators we’re looking for include:

  • 8–10+ years of professional experience in strategy consulting, digital transformation, AI, enterprise technology, or a similarly demanding environment.

  • Experience operating at Partner, Principal, Engagement Manager, Director, or equivalent level in a top-tier strategy consulting or transformation context.

  • A strong ability to structure ambiguous problems, identify value, and turn strategy into execution.

  • Experience leading large accounts, complex programs, or senior customer relationships.

  • The credibility to engage with executives and C-level stakeholders on business priorities, trade-offs, and impact.

  • Strong analytical and commercial judgment, with the ability to challenge assumptions constructively.

  • Comfort working at the frontier of technology, even when solutions are evolving quickly and the path is not fully defined.

  • A low-ego, high-ownership mindset and a desire to build with customers and teams, not just advise from a distance.

  • Fluency in English; German is a strong plus.

 

Hiring Process

 

• Talent Acquisition screening call

• 30min Hiring Manager Interview

• 45min Business Acumen Interview 

• 60min Technical Deep Dive on LLMs

• Panel (Home Prep & Restitution)

• 30min Value Talk

• Reference check

 

What We Offer

We offer a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your well-being, growth, and work-life balance. Benefits vary by country and may include healthcare coverage, parental leave, retirement plans, relocation support, wellness programs, meal and transportation allowances, and other location-specific perks.

jobs.title: Senior iOS Developer (Remote)
jobs.description:
About Finom
 
Finom is a European tech startup headquartered in Amsterdam, and we’re on a journey towards revolutionizing the financial landscape for entrepreneurs worldwide. Our mission is to develop an all-in-one financial B2B solution that integrates banking functions, accounting, financial management, and invoicing into a seamless, mobile-first platform.
 
We recently closed a €115 million Series C equity round (around $133 million), bringing our total funding to approximately $346 million. This significant investment follows a $105 million growth funding round from General Catalyst, a long-term backer since 2021 known for supporting companies like Airbnb, HubSpot, KAYAK, and Stripe.
 
Finom's platform goes beyond traditional banking, offering invoicing and a growing suite of features, including AI-enabled accounting, aiming to simplify financial management for entrepreneurs. We're actively expanding our reach across key EU markets like Germany, France, the Netherlands, Italy, and Spain.
 
At Finom, we’re not just redefining the entrepreneurial experience — we’re empowering our employees to make a real difference. Your work matters, and your impact extends far beyond product metrics. We nurture innovation and an inspiring work environment where bold ideas thrive, prioritizing thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and our business as a whole.
 
Maintaining our start-up spirit, we prioritize thorough research, swift implementation of solutions, and ensuring that every effort we make benefits our users, employees, partners, and, of course, our business.

The Role

For hundreds of thousands of European entrepreneurs, our iOS app is Finom. It's how they check their cash flow over morning coffee, approve a payment between client meetings, and freeze a card the moment something looks off. We're mobile-first by conviction, not convenience — the app isn't a companion to the "real" product; it is the product. And as an AI-native platform, the features you build increasingly carry intelligence inside them: AI-powered accounting, smart categorization, and agentic workflows that quietly save business owners hours every week. When you ship something great, someone somewhere feels it the same day.

That's why we're not looking for someone to implement tickets. We're looking for a Senior Mobile (iOS) Engineer who thinks like a product builder — someone who cares deeply about the "why" behind what they're building, challenges assumptions when needed, and proactively spots opportunities to create better outcomes.

You'll be embedded in a cross-functional domain team — Backend, Mobile, ML/AI, QA, Design, and Product — that owns a shared product area end-to-end. No handoff culture, no "not my layer": everyone in the team is solving the same customer problem, and you'll shape solutions from the first product conversation to the moment the feature is live in users' hands. Fewer silos means more flow — and real, end-to-end ownership.


What You Will Be Doing

How We Build

Agentic development is table stakes at Finom — for every craft, mobile included. Our engineers work with Claude Code and similar harnesses daily, and we've made it a first-class part of how the company operates, not an individual productivity hack. We follow a shared SDLC approach built around Spec-Driven Development (SDD): features start as clear, reviewable specs that both humans and AI agents execute against, powered by a shared AI development toolbelt and a growing library of skills, rules, and context maintained across guilds. You won't be figuring out AI-assisted development alone — you'll join an engineering organization that has already invested in the infrastructure, standards, and shared practices, and you'll be expected to use them, improve them, and raise the bar for others.

What You'll Do

  • Design and build new features for our iOS application, used daily by business owners across Europe: multi-account cash flow management, banking transactions and payments, physical and virtual card issuance and control, and AI-powered accounting automation.

  • Own outcomes, not just code. You'll follow your features into analytics, jump into customer issues without being prompted, and care about whether what you shipped actually moved the needle.

  • Build polished, responsive UIs with UIKit and SwiftUI — in a financial app, trust is built (or lost) in the details.

  • Drive technical decisions within your domain, discuss trade-offs openly with product managers, and explain constraints clearly to non-technical stakeholders.

  • Raise the bar on engineering quality — automated testing, thorough code reviews, and mobile security best practices are non-negotiable in a regulated fintech.

  • Mentor the engineers around you and contribute to CI/CD pipelines, tooling, and mobile best practices across the team.


Who You Are

Who You Are

You're pragmatic, learn quickly, and have a proven track record of shipping products that matter. Above all, you're curious — about the product, the users, the business, and how your technical decisions impact all three.

Curiosity. You want to understand the "why" behind every feature. You ask what problem it solves, question whether there's a simpler path, and explore how your decisions ripple into product, users, and revenue.

Business acumen. You connect your work to company objectives. You understand the "so what" behind every decision, and you'd rather ship the feature that moves the right metric than the one that's merely interesting to build.

Communication. You communicate clearly and concisely in English across technical and non-technical audiences — from fellow engineers to PMs to business stakeholders — and you genuinely enjoy the dynamics of a cross-functional team.

T-shapedness. Your iOS craft runs deep, but your curiosity runs wide. You'll peek at the backend contracts, ask questions about the ML models, and dive into analytics to understand how your features perform.

Ownership. You take responsibility not just for your code, but for the outcomes. You move without being prompted — whether that's improving team processes, jumping on a production issue, or mentoring a colleague.

Your Experience Includes

  • 5+ years of commercial iOS development with strong knowledge of Swift.

  • Deep understanding of OOP, SOLID principles, and design patterns.

  • Practical experience with the VIPER architectural pattern and the Coordinator navigation pattern — and the judgment to know when a simpler approach serves the product better.

  • Excellent knowledge of UIKit and experience (or a strong desire to grow) with SwiftUI.

  • Experience with layout development in code, particularly using SnapKit or similar tools.

  • Ability to write unit and UI tests.

  • Confidence with Git / GitLab, including setting up and maintaining GitLab CI/CD.

  • Hands-on experience with agentic development tools (Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot, or similar) as part of your daily workflow — writing prompts, configuring rules and skills, and critically evaluating AI-generated output with tests, linters, and review. This is table stakes for all engineering crafts at Finom, mobile included.

  • A builder's mentality: you care deeply about shipping great products, not just writing great code.

    • Nice to Have

    • Background in fintech or financial products — you understand the stakes of working in a regulated environment.

    • Solid grasp of mobile security best practices (especially critical in our domain).

    • Experience profiling and optimizing UI performance — reducing rendering bottlenecks and hitting smooth 60/120fps on iOS.

    • Hands-on work with performance tooling: Instruments, XCTest, or similar.

    • Published apps on the App Store you're proud of.

    • An active GitHub profile with code you're happy to share.

    • Deeper agentic engineering experience beyond daily tool use — setting up agent environments and harnesses, authoring reusable skills and behavioral rules, or contributing to a team's shared AI development practices.

    • Understanding of model capabilities and limitations — knowing which model fits which task and how to manage the context window effectively.

    • Awareness of AI security risks — prompt injection, data leakage, and safe handling of untrusted inputs in agentic workflows.

What You Will Get In Return
 
Make a genuine impact on the product
 
Join our upward trajectory, and grow with us. We provide the resources and opportunities for continuous personal and professional development, empowering you to make a genuine impact on our evolving product.
 
Work in the EU
 
Embark on this exciting journey with us and enjoy the flexibility of traveling and working remotely or in a hybrid model across Europe.
 
Become a stock options holder
 
Unlock your inner entrepreneur and align your aspirations with ours through our Stock Options Program. This exciting opportunity is available to every team member, from junior team members to our founders.
 
Receive unwavering support and care
 
Finom stands by you at every step, embodying our commitment to your well-being and success reflected in our modern, friendly, and eco-conscious corporate culture. We offer constant support and care to ensure your Finom experience is successful and fulfilling.
 
Work & Swim program
 
Immerse yourself in our exclusive Work & Swim Program. Spend one month in a comfortable corporate apartment in enchanting Cyprus. It's the ideal opportunity to strike the perfect work-life balance while enjoying breathtaking Mediterranean views.
 
Equal Opportunity Statement 
 
At Finom, we're an equal opportunity employer and value diversity at our company. We embrace diversity and invite applications from all walks of life. We do not discriminate based on race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability status, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

jobs.title: Manager, Global Partner Marketing (East Coast or EMEA Preferred)
jobs.description:
About Docker

Docker has been one of the most loved brands in developer tooling, trusted by more than 20 million monthly users and over 20 billion container image pulls. From solo founders to the world's largest companies, developers rely on Docker to build, share, and run their applications across our suite of products including Docker Desktop, Docker Hub, and Docker Scout.

We are a globally distributed, remote-first team building the tools that define how software gets built and delivered. As AI agents redefine software development, Docker is at the center of that shift, providing the sandboxed environments, verified images, and secure infrastructure that make autonomous workflows trustworthy by default.

_______________________________________________________________________

Docker's partner ecosystem, spanning technology partners, GSIs, ISVs, resellers, distributors, and cloud alliances, is how Docker extends its reach into enterprise accounts beyond direct sales coverage. Docker is investing meaningfully in this ecosystem, and the Manager, Global Partner Marketing owns the marketing function that powers it.

As Docker enters its next stage of growth, this is a role for a builder: someone ready to evolve partner marketing from a set of discrete activities into a comprehensive, end-to-end strategy, integrated with Docker's broader GTM and marketing motions and aligned with our partner ecosystem goals. You will define how Docker shows up for its partners globally, from portal governance and MDF strategy to co-marketing campaigns, events, and the sales-ready assets that equip partners to win in market. You will set the function's strategy, standards, and operating model, and build the roadmap and team that scale with the business.

You will operate as the marketing counterpart to senior ecosystem leadership, including the VP of Partnerships and Alliances and the broader Global Alliances team: setting the partner marketing agenda, driving global initiatives that accelerate ecosystem growth, and representing partner marketing in Docker's marketing and alliances leadership forums. You will also partner closely with the Strategic Partner Program Director to bring the partner program to life, ensuring every element is supported with the right content, campaigns, and tools. The role reports to the Sr. Director, Growth Marketing.

WHAT SUCCESS LOOKS LIKE

Partner marketing at Docker is a measurable contributor to revenue growth. The strategy you set carries pipeline targets, the MDF budget you own carries ROI reporting, and the portal you govern shows adoption and engagement trending up.

Your work spans three motions: marketing to partners, keeping them engaged, informed, and enabled; marketing through partners, equipping them to carry Docker into their markets; and marketing with partners, co-marketing that generates pipeline for both sides.

You operate at every altitude, internally and externally: with senior leaders, with partners in region, and with the execution-level stakeholders across marketing, the partner organization, product, and other cross-functional teams who ship the work alongside you. Your decisions are grounded in data. And you do not just stay close to the work, you do the work: this function starts with you as both its builder and its operator. Your collaboration with field marketing across EMEA, Americas, and APAC will be critical to keeping partner marketing globally consistent and locally relevant, and over time you build what lasts: the processes, standards, operating model, and eventually the team that let partner marketing scale beyond any one person.

RESPONSIBILITIES

Strategy & Function Leadership

  • Own and lead Docker's global partner marketing function: strategy, budget, standards, and operating model, including the structure, resourcing, and team the function needs as Docker's ecosystem scales.

  • Build and maintain the annual Global Partner Marketing Plan, defining spend allocation, pipeline targets, and the marketing motions that support partner-led growth across all tiers and geographies.

  • Serve as the marketing counterpart to alliances leadership: shape ecosystem GTM strategy with the VP of Partnerships and Alliances, carry credibility with senior partner executives, and own quarterly planning and reporting on partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline, MDF ROI, and portal adoption.

Partner Campaigns & Pipeline

  • Translate partner program requirements into scalable campaigns and marketing motions that partners can execute independently or co-execute with Docker, and own the partner marketing calendar in sync with corporate marketing, product launches, and field marketing.

  • Operationalize partner lead management with the Strategic Partner Program Director and Partner Operations, driving joint demand generation programs that produce qualified leads and tracking the partner pipeline they create.

Partner Communications, Portal & Content

  • Lead all partner-facing communications on a cadence that keeps partners engaged, informed, and enabled, with the Partner Portal as a key channel.

  • Lead Partner Portal (PRM) governance and optimization with the Strategic Partner Program Director, keeping content current and well-organized across tiers and partner types, and driving engagement and adoption.

  • Own partner-facing messaging and content: Docker's partner web presence, the value story for each partner segment, and a comprehensive asset library that equips partners to sell Docker in market.

Partner MDF & Co-Marketing

  • Own the global Partner MDF program end to end, from program design and eligibility through approval, activity tracking, compliance, and ROI reporting.

  • Develop MDF-funded co-marketing plans with partners that drive pipeline and brand awareness on both sides.

Partner Events & Webinars

  • Set Docker's partner event strategy and execute it with Field Marketing, the Events team, and local partner teams: partner summits, partner tracks at DockerCon and industry events, webinars, and roadshows.

  • Ensure every activation carries a follow-up motion that converts engagement into pipeline.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 8+ years in partner, channel, or ecosystem marketing, ideally in B2B SaaS or open-source software, with a proven track record of building and scaling global partner marketing programs and the pipeline results to show for it.

  • Leadership experience: you have led a function, managed or mentored marketers, or operated as the senior-most partner marketing voice in an organization, and you are ready to build and lead a team as the function scales.

  • Hands-on command of the partner marketing toolkit: PRM platforms, MDF programs and co-marketing budgets with ROI reporting, and the core marketing stack (Salesforce, Marketo or HubSpot, Asana or similar).

  • Data-driven operator: comfortable with pipeline reporting, MDF ROI analysis, and portal engagement metrics, and able to run multiple workstreams across time zones.

  • Executive-level communication and collaboration: you can set an agenda with a VP, write for partners and developers, defend a budget with data, and build trust with senior stakeholders inside and outside the company.

  • A global mindset, attuned to regional nuances across EMEA, Americas, and APAC, and a builder mentality: energized by creating the strategy, processes, and team from the ground up.

  • Familiarity with developer tools, container technology, or cloud-native ecosystems is a strong advantage.

WHAT TO EXPECT

This role starts in execution. There are partner-facing moments already on the calendar in your first quarter that you will help land while you build the function underneath them.

First 30 Days

  • Immerse in Docker's product, partner ecosystem, and program structure, and align with Growth Marketing leadership, the VP of Partnerships and Alliances, the Global Alliances team, and the Strategic Partner Program Director on priorities and the near-term moments the ecosystem team is counting on.

  • Audit the current state across partner assets, portal content, communications, MDF, and in-flight co-marketing, and connect with field marketing across EMEA, Americas, and APAC plus Product Marketing, Demand Generation, and Corporate Communications.

  • Form a first view on what the function needs to scale: budget, resourcing, and operating model.

First 90 Days

  • Land the in-flight partner marketing moments of the quarter: communications, webinars, event presence, and the supporting assets partners need, delivered on time and on message.

  • Stand up the foundations: a partner communication cadence partners can rely on, portal governance with refreshed content across tiers and partner types, and an operational MDF program with its first ROI baseline.

  • Ship the annual Global Partner Marketing Plan, covering spend allocation, pipeline targets, and priority activities by tier and geography, with a resourcing roadmap attached, and establish the leadership review cadence with Growth Marketing and Alliances.

One Year Outlook

  • Partner marketing is a measurable contributor to Docker's revenue growth, with clean attribution on partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and a reporting rhythm leadership trusts.

  • The foundations run at target: the portal is the trusted home for partner content, the MDF program funds the co-marketing that works, the asset library is live and actively used by partners, and the events engine converts engagement into pipeline.

  • The function has a clear strategy, operating model, and resourcing plan, with the team taking shape as it scales.

Docker does not offer visa sponsorship for this role.

 

Compensation & Equity

EU: €95,900 – €137,000 + equity

United States: $147,000– $210,000 + equity

______________________________________________________________________

Posting Information

  • Open vacancy: This posting is for an existing open role.

  • AI in hiring: Docker may use AI-assisted tools during our recruiting process.

  • Interview recordings: Candidates will be invited to opt in to interview recordings to support interviewer calibration and consistent evaluations. Recordings are optional and require explicit consent.

______________________________________________________________________

Perks & Benefits

  • Remote-first by design – Work from your home, with offices in Seattle and Paris for connection and collaboration.

  • Flexibility that fits your life – We trust you to manage your schedule while delivering great work.

  • Time to recharge – Generous PTO, designated quarterly Whaleness Days, and a designated end-of-year Whaleness break.

  • Home office support – Set up your workspace for comfort and success.

  • Technology stipend – Equivalent to US$100 net per month to help support your work.

  • Learning & development – Annual stipend for conferences, courses, certifications, and continued learning.

  • Parental leave – 16 weeks of paid parental leave after six months of employment.

  • Equity for all full-time employees – Share in Docker's long-term success as we continue to grow.

  • Comprehensive benefits – Medical, retirement, and paid holidays vary by country.

  • Docker swag – Because representing the whale never gets old.

Docker is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to building a team that reflects a broad range of backgrounds, experiences, and perspectives. We believe diverse teams build better products, make better decisions, and better serve our global community.
