jobs.title: Director, Credit Risk
jobs.description:
About Airwallex

Airwallex is the only unified payments and financial platform for global businesses. Powered by our unique combination of proprietary infrastructure and software, we empower over 250,000 businesses worldwide – including Brex, Navan, Qantas, SHEIN and many more – with fully integrated solutions to manage everything from business accounts, payments, spend management and treasury, to embedded finance at a global scale.

Proudly founded in Melbourne, we have a team of over 2,300 of the brightest and most innovative people in tech across 27 offices around the globe. Valued at US$11 billion and backed by world-leading investors including T. Rowe Price, Visa, Mastercard, Robinhood Ventures, Sequoia, Salesforce Ventures, DST Global, and Lone Pine Capital, Airwallex is leading the charge in building the global payments and financial platform of the future. If you’re ready to do the most ambitious work of your career, join us.

 

Attributes We Value

We hire successful builders with founder-like energy who want real impact, accelerated learning, and true ownership. You bring strong role-related expertise and sharp thinking, and you’re motivated by our mission and operating principles. You move fast with good judgment, dig deep with curiosity, and make decisions from first principles, balancing speed and rigor.

You're humble and collaborative; turn zero‑to‑one ideas into real products, and you “get stuff done” end-to-end. You use AI to work smarter and solve problems faster. Here, you’ll tackle complex, high‑visibility problems with exceptional teammates and grow your career as we build the future of global banking. If that sounds like you, let’s build what’s next.

 

About the team
The Credit Risk team is part of Airwallex’s Second Line of Defence and helps the company grow responsibly as a global financial platform.
We work at the intersection of credit, FX, and counterparty risk, partnering closely with Product, Sales, Operations, Treasury, Finance, Engineering, Compliance, and Legal to enable commercial growth while protecting Airwallex from financial loss and excessive risk exposure. This is a team for analytical, commercially minded risk leaders who are energized by building scalable frameworks and practical controls across a fast-moving, multi-currency global network.

What you'll do
As Director, Credit Risk, you will lead Airwallex's global second-line oversight of credit, FX, and counterparty risk. You will set the risk guardrails that allow the business to grow safely across merchant acquiring, charge cards, FX, treasury, settlement, and banking-partner activities. Reporting to the Senior Director, Financial Risk, you will own the global framework, risk appetite, limits, governance, and portfolio oversight for these risk areas. You will provide independent challenge to first-line decisions and act as a trusted advisor to senior leaders across the business.

This role is based in London.

Responsibilities

  • Credit risk framework and risk appetite: Define, implement, and continuously enhance the global second-line credit risk framework, including policies, risk appetite thresholds, limits, escalation protocols, and governance standards across Airwallex’s products and legal entities.

  • Credit portfolio oversight: Oversee credit exposures across merchant acquiring, charge cards, B2B and commercial activities, FX pre-funding, treasury-related exposures, settlement flows, and other relevant products.

  • Underwriting and limit governance: Review and challenge first-line underwriting strategies, customer and merchant risk policies, credit assessments, limit-setting methodologies, and exception processes. Act as a senior escalation point for complex or high-value credit decisions.

  • FX risk oversight: Establish and monitor appropriate second-line guardrails for FX exposures arising from pre-funding, settlement, customer activity, treasury flows, and other multi-currency activities. Challenge controls, limits, escalation triggers, and risk reporting to ensure exposures remain within approved tolerances.

  • Counterparty risk management: Set and oversee counterparty risk standards for banking partners, payment partners, merchants, customers, and other material counterparties. Establish appropriate exposure limits, concentration thresholds, monitoring requirements, and escalation processes.

  • Portfolio monitoring and early warning indicators: Lead proactive monitoring of credit, FX, and counterparty portfolios, including exposure, concentration, delinquency, default, chargeback, loss, settlement, liquidity-of-counterparty, and other relevant risk indicators. Identify emerging trends and escalate material issues before they become systemic.

  • Loss mitigation and remediation: Review and challenge first-line monitoring, collections, collateral, prefunding, reserves, chargeback, and other mitigation strategies. Ensure deteriorating counterparties, customers, merchants, or exposures are identified and addressed promptly.

  • New products and market expansion: Partner with Product, Engineering, Commercial, Treasury, Finance, and Operations to assess and challenge the risk design of new products, features, markets, currencies, and partner arrangements before launch.

  • Risk approvals and governance: Lead or support risk committee decisions, material risk approvals, limit exceptions, breach assessments, and remediation plans. Ensure decisions are documented clearly and aligned with approved risk appetite.

  • Regulatory and partner engagement: Represent Credit Risk during regulatory examinations, internal and external audits, and reviews with banking and strategic partners. Prepare clear, decision-useful materials for senior management, risk committees, and the Board where appropriate.

Who you are
We're looking for people who meet the minimum requirements for this role. The preferred qualifications are great to have, but are not mandatory.



Minimum qualifications

  • 10–15 years of progressively senior experience across credit risk, counterparty risk, FX risk, treasury risk, or related financial risk disciplines within banking, payments, fintech, or another highly regulated financial services environment.

  • Deep experience designing, implementing, and governing second-line credit risk frameworks in a complex, multi-jurisdictional organization.

  • Strong understanding of credit risk identification, measurement, underwriting, limit management, monitoring, mitigation, provisioning, loss recognition, and capital implications.

  • Demonstrated experience managing risk across multiple product lines, such as merchant acquiring, commercial or charge cards, B2B lending, payment processing, FX, treasury, settlement, or banking-partner activities.

  • Practical experience overseeing FX and counterparty risk, including exposure measurement, concentration risk, limits, settlement risk, prefunding, collateral or other mitigants, and escalation governance.

  • Proven ability to challenge first-line decisions and communicate clear risk positions to senior executives, commercial leaders, product and operations teams, banking partners, auditors, and regulators.

Preferred qualifications

  • Advanced degree such as an MBA or Master's in Finance, Economics, Risk Management, or a related field.

  • Professional certification such as FRM, PRM, CFA, or an equivalent qualification.

  • Experience with automated decisioning engines, credit scoring models, portfolio analytics, or alternative data used in underwriting and monitoring.

  • Familiarity with IFRS 9, expected credit loss methodologies, stress testing, or other relevant prudential and accounting frameworks.

  • Strong data literacy and familiarity with SQL, Python, or similar tools used to analyze portfolio, exposure, and loss trends.

  • Experience working in a regulated payments fintech, digital bank, or financial institution with multiple licenses and banking partnerships.

  • Comfort operating in a high-growth environment with evolving priorities and a bias for practical, scalable execution.

Applicant Safety Policy: Fraud and Third-Party Recruiters

To protect you from recruitment scams, please be aware that Airwallex will not ask for bank details, sensitive ID numbers (i.e. passport), or any form of payment during the application or interview process. All official communication will come from an @airwallex.com email address. Please apply only through careers.airwallex.com or our official LinkedIn page.

Airwallex does not accept unsolicited resumes from search firms/recruiters. Airwallex will not pay any fees to search firms/recruiters if a candidate is submitted by a search firm/recruiter unless an agreement has been entered into with respect to specific open position(s). Search firms/recruiters submitting resumes to Airwallex on an unsolicited basis shall be deemed to accept this condition, regardless of any other provision to the contrary.

Equal opportunity

Airwallex is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and anyone seeking employment at Airwallex is considered based on merit, qualifications, competence and talent. We don’t regard color, religion, race, national origin, sexual orientation, ancestry, citizenship, sex, marital or family status, disability, gender, or any other legally protected status when making our hiring decisions. If you have a disability or special need that requires accommodation, please let us know.

jobs.title: Senior Footwear Designer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Stellenbeschreibung

Du siehst einen Trend und denkst nicht: „Das könnten wir auch machen.“

Du denkst drei Schritte weiter.

Was kommt danach? Was passt zu unserer Kundin? Und wie machen wir daraus etwas, das eindeutig Pammys ist?

Du hast ein außergewöhnliches Gespür für Schuhe, Fashion, Farben, Materialien und Silhouetten und gleichzeitig genug kommerzielles Verständnis, um zu wissen, dass ein großartiges Produkt nicht nur auf einem Moodboard funktionieren muss.

Es muss gekauft werden.

Pammys ist in nur vier Jahren auf über 1 Million Kundinnen und Kunden gewachsen. Heute arbeiten über 150 Mitarbeitende daran, aus Pammys eine internationale Footwear Brand zu machen.

Mit unserer nächsten Wachstumsphase bauen wir unser Produktportfolio deutlich aus und entwickeln Pammys von einzelnen erfolgreichen Produkten zu einer starken internationalen Footwear Brand.

Dafür suchen wir einen Senior Footwear Designer (m/w/d), der unsere zukünftigen Kollektionen und Produkte maßgeblich mitgestaltet.

Du bekommst keine fertigen Ideen zum Ausarbeiten.

Wir erwarten, dass die besten Ideen von dir kommen.


Deine Aufgaben

  • Entwicklung neuer Footwear-Konzepte, Modelle und Kollektionen von der ersten Idee bis zum finalen Design
  • Übersetzung von Fashion-, Footwear-, Consumer- und Cultural Trends in kommerziell relevante Produkte für Pammys
  • Entwicklung von Silhouetten, Colorways, Materialien, Details, Sohlen und Designkonzepten
  • Aufbau von saisonalen Creative Directions, Moodboards, Color & Material Stories und Collection Concepts
  • Kontinuierliche Analyse internationaler Runways, Brands, Retailer, Social Media und Streetstyle-Trends
  • Entwicklung einer eigenständigen Pammys Design DNA und konsequente Weiterentwicklung unserer visuellen Produktsprache
  • Erstellung professioneller Sketches, Renderings und Design Specifications für die weitere Produktentwicklung
  • Enge Zusammenarbeit mit Product Development, Technical Development, Sourcing und Merchandising vom ersten Konzept bis zur Produktionsreife
  • Bewertung und Weiterentwicklung von Samples mit Fokus auf Design, Proportionen, Materialien, Farben und Details
  • Nutzung von Sales Data, Customer Feedback und Marktinformationen, um bestehende Bestseller weiterzuentwickeln und neue Produktchancen zu identifizieren
  • Regelmäßige internationale Trend-, Messe-, Markt- und Lieferantenreisen, um Entwicklungen früh zu erkennen und Produkte direkt vor Ort weiterzuentwickeln


Dein Profil

  • Langjährige Erfahrung als Footwear Designer oder Senior Footwear Designer, idealerweise bei einer relevanten Fashion-, Footwear-, Lifestyle- oder Consumer Brand
  • Starkes Portfolio mit nachweislich realisierten und kommerziell erfolgreichen Footwear-Produkten
  • Herausragendes Gespür für Silhouetten, Proportionen, Farben, Materialien und Details
  • Tiefes Verständnis aktueller Footwear-, Fashion-, Lifestyle- und Consumer-Trends
  • Fähigkeit, Trends nicht einfach zu kopieren, sondern daraus eine eigenständige und kommerziell relevante Designsprache zu entwickeln
  • Erfahrung in der Entwicklung vollständiger Kollektionen, saisonaler Konzepte und Produktfamilien
  • Sehr gutes Verständnis des gesamten Footwear-Entwicklungsprozesses von Design über Sampling bis zur Produktion
  • Sicherer Umgang mit Adobe Illustrator, Photoshop und relevanten Design-Tools, Erfahrung mit 3D- und AI-basierten Design-Workflows ist ein großes Plus
  • Starkes kommerzielles Verständnis und die Fähigkeit, Kreativität, Customer Needs und Verkaufspotenzial miteinander zu verbinden
  • Erfahrung in der direkten Zusammenarbeit mit Product Development, Fabriken und internationalen Produktionspartnern
  • Sehr hohe visuelle Standards und gleichzeitig Geschwindigkeit in der Entwicklung und Umsetzung
  • Ausgeprägte Eigeninitiative und eine klare kreative Meinung
  • Hohe internationale Reisebereitschaft für Trend Research, Messen, Lieferanten und Produktionspartner
  • Sehr gute Englischkenntnisse, Deutschkenntnisse sind von Vorteil


Deine Vorteile bei Pammys

  • Product Impact: Deine Designs werden zu Produkten, die von einer internationalen Customer Base getragen werden
  • Creative Ownership: Gestalte die zukünftige Design DNA und Produktsprache von Pammys maßgeblich mit
  • Scale: Entwickle Kollektionen für eine Footwear Brand mit über 1 Million Kundinnen und Kunden

jobs.description:
Über uns

Wie bleibt ein RAG-System präzise, wenn aus tausend Dokumenten hunderttausend werden? Wie orchestriert man mehrere Modellanbieter sauber hinter einer Oberfläche? Während anderswo noch Prototypen gezeigt werden, arbeiten unsere Kunden längst damit - mit ihren Daten, ihren Regeln, gehostet in Deutschland. Als Senior Engineer verantwortest du Kernfunktionen und Architektur unserer Plattform, vom Retrieval bis ins Frontend - und du entwickelst sie so, wie wir arbeiten: AI-gestützt, mit Coding-Agents als Teil des Werkzeugkastens und mit echtem Gestaltungsspielraum für deine Ideen. Du suchst eine Rolle, in der technische Tiefe und Produktverantwortung zusammenkommen? Dann sollten wir uns kennenlernen!


Das gibt es zu tun

  • Architektur & Umsetzung Du entwirfst und skalierst verteilte Systeme und Microservices - immer mit Blick auf Wartbarkeit, Stabilität und die Frage, was in zwei Jahren noch trägt. 
  • KI-Features bauen, die im Alltag halten Du entwickelst die Kernfunktionen unserer Plattform - von RAG-basierten Wissensdatenbanken über KI-Apps für einzelne Fachbereiche bis zu Voice-, Übersetzungs- und Analytics-Funktionen. 
  • Full-Stack liefern Du entwickelst performante APIs, modellierst Daten und Datenbanken und setzt moderne Oberflächen im Frontend um - vom Retrieval bis zur Benutzeroberfläche.
  • Daten, Sicherheit & Mandantenfähigkeit Du modellierst Daten für Multi-Tenancy und rollenbasierte Berechtigungen - so, dass niemand über die KI Zugriff auf etwas bekommt, das er nicht sehen darf. Verschlüsselung, Datenminimierung und Auditierbarkeit denkst du von Anfang an mit. 
  • Betrieb & Observability mitdenken Du sorgst dafür, dass Qualität, Kosten und Verhalten der KI-Features im Betrieb sichtbar bleiben - mit Evaluations, Monitoring und klaren Guardrails, damit die Plattform auch bei wachsender Nutzung stabil und effizient läuft.
  • Komplexität beherrschen Du entwickelst bestehende Systeme weiter, schaffst klare Strukturen und reduzierst technische Schulden dort, wo sie langfristig teuer werden und lässt sie stehen, wo sie es nicht sind. 
  • AI-gestützt entwickeln – und den Standard dafür setzen Du arbeitest selbstverständlich mit Coding-Assistenten und Agenten, holst mehr aus ihnen heraus als Autocomplete und weißt genau, wo ihre Grenzen liegen. Neue Tools und Workflows testest du früh, bewertest sie ehrlich und etablierst im Team, wie wir sie sinnvoll einsetzen.
  • Team & Produkt weiterbringen Du arbeitest eng mit Product Owner, UX und unseren Consultants zusammen, übersetzt echte Kunden-Use-Cases in Technik, machst technische Entscheidungen transparent und bringst unsere Junior Developer durch Code Reviews und Mentoring fachlich weiter. 


Das bringst Du mit

  • Mindestens 5 Jahre Erfahrung in der Entwicklung komplexer Softwaresysteme, idealerweise im KI- bzw. SaaS/Cloud-Umfeld
  • Sehr gute TypeScript-Kenntnisse, Erfahrung mit Node.js und idealerweise Frameworks wie NestJS 
  • Sehr gute Kenntnisse in Softwarearchitektur für verteilte Systeme - Microservices, API-Design, Skalierung 
  • Erfahrung im Frontend, z. B. mit Vue.js, sowie ein gutes Verständnis für Full-Stack-Zusammenhänge 
  • Fundierte Kenntnisse im Umgang mit Datenbanken (z. B. PostgreSQL), Datenmodellierung und Performance-Optimierung 
  • Erfahrung mit Cloud-Plattformen (z. B. AWS), Docker und dem Betrieb von SaaS-Anwendungen 
  • AI-gestütztes Entwickeln ist für dich Alltag: Du arbeitest routiniert mit Coding-Assistenten und -Agenten (z. B. Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot), kennst ihre Grenzen und prüfst generierten Code kritisch, statt ihm zu vertrauen 
  • Du bist nah am Puls der Entwicklung: Du probierst neue Tools, Modelle und Workflows aktiv aus und bringst die guten ins Team - Erfahrung mit agentischen Setups (z. B. Coding-Agents in der Cloud, MCP-Integrationen, automatisierte Reviews) ist ein starkes Plus 
  • Tieferes Verständnis moderner AI-/LLM-Konzepte wie RAG, Function Calling, Embeddings oder Agenten
  • Clean Code, Testing und Code Reviews sind für dich selbstverständlich und du bringst Junior Developers durch Reviews und Mentoring gern fachlich weiter 
  • Du triffst technische Entscheidungen und kannst sie nachvollziehbar vertreten - auf Deutsch und auf Englisch 
  • Erfahrung mit DSGVO, ISO 27001 oder dem EU AI Act sind ein Plus 

Was uns wichtig ist 
Frameworks kann man lernen. Was uns viel wichtiger ist: Verantwortung übernehmen, das Produkt mitdenken, Anforderungen konstruktiv hinterfragen und technische Entscheidungen treffen, die man auch in zwei Jahren noch begründen kann - pragmatisch abgewogen zwischen Perfektion und Geschwindigkeit. Konkret heißt das: Du entwirfst morgens die Architektur für ein neues Feature, reviewst mittags Pull Requests, entwickelst nachmittags selbst und bringst dabei unser Team fachlich weiter. Wer lieber Tickets abarbeitet und auf Anforderungen wartet, wird bei uns nicht glücklich.


Das bekommst Du

  • Start & Welcoming so wie du es verdienst! Ein strukturiertes Onboarding mit echten Ansprechpersonen - damit du vom ersten Tag an durchstartest.
  • Remote Work Homeoffice innerhalb von Deutschland oder Arbeiten in unserem modernen Büro in Offenburg? Arbeite so, wie es für dich am besten passt.
  • AI-first arbeiten, statt darüber zu reden Lizenzen für Claude Code, Cursor, Copilot & Co. stellen wir. Neue Tools und Modelle darfst du ausprobieren, statt sie zu beantragen – und deine Erkenntnisse verändern, wie das ganze Team arbeitet. 
  • Kurze Wege, keine Entscheidungsgremien Architekturentscheidungen trifft das Team, das sie später auch betreibt. Deine Ideen landen im Produkt, nicht in einem Backlog-Archiv. 
  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge mit 20 % Arbeitgeberzuschuss - deutlich über dem gesetzlichen Standard.
  • Du entscheidest ob Hansefit-Mitgliedschaft oder 50 € monatlich per Spendit Card - dein Benefit, deine Wahl.
  • Urlaub, der mit dir wächst: 30 Tage Jahresurlaub + dazu Weihnachten und Silvester frei - und mit steigender Betriebszugehörigkeit kommen weitere Tage dazu. 
  • Jobticket oder JobRad - wir machen deinen Weg ins Office einfacher und grüner.
  • Feiern gehört dazu - Quarterly Allhands Events, Sommerfest, Weihnachtsfeier oder einfach so - wir wissen, wie man Korken knallen lässt.
  • Ein Team, das wirklich zählt. Flache Hierarchien, schnelle Entscheidungen und ein offenes Ohr auch für das, was dich persönlich bewegt.


Das sind WIR

Transformation ist für uns kein Trend, sondern unser Auftrag: Seit 1995 begleitet die avenit Group Unternehmen dabei, sich für die digitale Zukunft neu aufzustellen - ganzheitlich, strategisch und mit klarem Blick für nachhaltige Erfolge. Mit avenit und Vusyon vereinen wir zwei starke Kräfte - langjährige führende Digitalexpertise und modernste KI-Technologie - zu einem Partner für maßgeschneiderte Lösungen, die wirklich funktionieren. Wir glauben daran, dass nachhaltiger Erfolg auf Augenhöhe entsteht; im echten Dialog mit unseren Kunden. Unsere 60 Kolleg:innen lassen diese Vision jeden Tag zur Realität werden. Werde Teil eines Teams, das Zukunft nicht nur denkt, sondern gestaltet.

Unser innovatives KI-Team in der Vusyon GmbH sucht Verstärkung, um unsere KI-Plattform für den Mittelstand weiter zu entwickeln. Neugierig, was uns dort besonders macht? Mehr erfährst du hier: https://vusyon.ai/

jobs.description:
Stora is looking for a Head of Sales to take ownership of the sales function as the business moves into its next stage of growth.

This is a hands-on leadership role, not a manage-from-the-sidelines one.

There is already a product customers want, an established position in the UK and Ireland, growing European opportunity, and a sales team in place. The challenge now is to turn that foundation into a more predictable, repeatable commercial engine.

You’ll work directly with the CEO, lead SDRs and Account Executives, improve how pipeline is created and converted, and bring greater clarity to forecasting, performance and where the next growth opportunities sit.

The opportunity

Stora has grown quickly, but the next stage requires more than simply doing more of what worked before.

The Head of Sales will be expected to answer questions like:

  • Where should the team focus its time and why?

  • How does outbound become consistently productive?

  • Where are deals getting stuck?

  • How should SDRs and AEs be coached and developed?

  • Which segments and markets represent the strongest opportunities?

  • What needs to change in the sales motion as Stora moves upmarket and expands internationally?

  • How does the business build a forecast leadership can genuinely rely on?

This is a role with real authority to improve things, alongside accountability for the results.

What you’ll own

  • Sales strategy and execution

  • Leadership, coaching and development of the SDR and AE team

  • Outbound performance and pipeline generation

  • Sales process from first engagement through to closed-won

  • Forecasting, pipeline health and revenue visibility

  • Performance management and clear expectations across the team

  • Key and strategically important opportunities where senior involvement can make a difference

  • Close alignment with Marketing and Product around ICP, messaging, customer insight and market opportunity

You’ll also stay close to customers and deals.

Stora wants a sales leader who knows what is happening on the ground, not someone whose understanding of the market comes entirely from dashboards and weekly reports.

What a strong candidate looks like

Stora needs a hands-on B2B SaaS sales leader who can build consistent performance, not just manage what already exists.

You’re likely someone who:

  • Has a genuine hunter mentality and knows how to create pipeline, not just manage what lands

  • Has led and developed SaaS sales teams and can raise the standard of performance around them

  • Knows what good outbound looks like and can coach it properly

  • Has personally sold into SMB and/or mid-market customers and can still step into important deals when needed

  • Builds healthier, more predictable pipeline and brings strong forecasting discipline

  • Qualifies hard, prioritises well and is comfortable walking away from weak opportunities

  • Uses data to improve decisions without hiding behind dashboards

  • Challenges assumptions, spots where the sales motion is weak and acts on it

  • Sets clear expectations, coaches directly and holds people accountable

  • Can move comfortably between commercial strategy with the CEO, coaching the team and getting involved in a deal that matters

  • Has the commercial instinct to spot new segments, markets or opportunities worth pursuing

This is still a stage where leadership means building as well as leading. If you want to inherit a large sales organisation, established territories and a finished playbook, this probably is not the role.

Experience in vertical SaaS, operationally complex industries or international markets would be useful, but none are essential.

Why Stora

Stora builds the software self storage operators use to run and grow their businesses, covering areas including bookings, payments, facility management, reporting and automation.

The business has established strong traction in the UK and Ireland and is continuing to expand across Europe and other international markets.

For a Head of Sales, that creates an interesting point to join:

  • A proven product rather than an early experiment

  • Existing customers and market credibility

  • A sales team already in place

  • Significant European market opportunity ahead

  • Direct access to the CEO and leadership team

  • The ability to meaningfully shape commercial strategy

  • Share options and genuine participation in the upside created

The foundations exist. The opportunity is to build what comes next.

Location

Stora operates as a distributed business across the UK and Europe.

Being based in Northern Ireland would be particularly useful given the proximity to the CEO and leadership team, although strong candidates elsewhere in the UK or EU will absolutely be considered.

What Stora offers

  • Competitive base salary plus uncapped commission plan

  • Share options

  • 35 days annual leave

  • Private health insurance for you and your family

  • Company pension

  • Apple hardware

  • Work from home budget

  • Learning and development support

  • Regular in-person team events and company meet-ups

Next steps

Applications are reviewed as they come in and Stora will move quickly where there is a strong fit.

Equal opportunities

Stora is committed to creating a workplace where people are treated fairly, with dignity and respect.

Applications are welcomed from suitably qualified candidates regardless of age, disability, gender, gender reassignment, marital or civil partnership status, pregnancy or maternity, race, religious belief or political opinion, or sexual orientation.

Recruitment decisions are based on merit, capability and business need.

If you require reasonable adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process, please let the team know.

jobs.title: Staff Software Engineer | Developer Experience
jobs.description:
Meet DeepL

DeepL is a global AI product and research company focused on building secure, intelligent solutions to complex business problems. Over 200,000 business customers and millions of individuals across 228 global markets today trust DeepL's Language AI platform for human-like translation, improved writing and real-time voice translation.
Founded in 2017 by CEO Jaroslaw “Jarek” Kutylowski, DeepL now has around 1,000 passionate employees and is supported by world-renowned investors including Benchmark, IVP, and Index Ventures.

Our goal is to become the global leader in trusted, intelligent AI technology, building products that drive better communication, foster connections, and create a meaningful impact. To achieve this, we need talented people like you to join our journey. If you’re ready to shape the future of AI and grow your career in a fast-moving, purpose-driven environment, DeepL is your next destination.

What sets us apart

What sets us apart is our blend of cutting-edge AI technology, meaningful work, and a culture where people truly thrive. We’re a team of innovators, researchers, and creators driven by a shared purpose to unlock human potential by making work simpler, smarter, and more connected.

When we share what it’s like to work at DeepL, the reactions are overwhelmingly positive. This might be because of our technology that helps millions of people and businesses communicate and work better every day, or because of the trust, curiosity, and care that shape our culture.

What we know for sure is this: being part of DeepL means joining a team dedicated to innovation, growth, and well-being. Discover more about life at DeepL onLinkedIn,Instagram, and our Blog.

Meet the team behind this journey

You will join the Developer Experience track, whose customers are DeepL's own engineers. Every change that reaches our products, from a research prototype to a production release, travels through the platform, pipelines and workflows this track owns. Our job is to make that journey fast, safe and obvious, so that engineers spend their time on the problems only they can solve.

That ownership runs the full width of the developer's day. It covers the foundation: source control, the CI and CD fleet that runs every pipeline across Kubernetes, macOS and Windows, build and dependency caching, and the artifact and package registries that hold what we ship. Having recently moved our source and CI onto GitLab SaaS, we are now shaping what a genuinely self-service platform looks like on top of it.

It also covers everything an engineer actually touches: our internal developer portal and service catalogue in Backstage, the Golden Path templates and release automation that make the right thing the easy thing, automated guardrails for security and production readiness, self-service access management, and the AI tooling our engineers use every day, including AI-assisted code review. We measure whether any of it is working, through developer surveys and delivery metrics.

We treat developer experience as a product, not a support function. We are opinionated about paved roads, allergic to mandates without migration paths, and increasingly focused on a question the whole industry is still answering: what does an engineering organisation look like when AI is a first-class part of how software gets built?

Your responsibilities

  • Own technical direction for a significant part of the Developer Experience mandate. Identify where the biggest friction sits for our engineers, form a clear position on how to remove it, and see that work through to adoption.

  • Lead initiatives that lift developer productivity across multiple engineering teams, by understanding and improving processes and tooling, and by drawing on both established software engineering practice and AI capability.

  • Design and build the workflows and tooling that carry a change through the software development lifecycle, from local development through review to release.

  • Lead our work on AI across that lifecycle. Evaluate what genuinely helps, build the guardrails that make it safe and useful at our scale, and be candid about what does not work.

  • Treat internal developers as customers and grow a community around developer experience. Talk to them, watch where they struggle, and let evidence decide what to build and whether it landed, whether that evidence is survey data, delivery metrics or support load. Empower product teams to own their delivery journey, and turn consensus across engineering into shipped change. Much of the work at this level is influence without authority.

  • Define standards that hold across the track and drive migrations to them, bringing teams along with a working path rather than a deadline.

  • Mentor engineers across the track and raise the technical bar of the group, through design reviews, architecture decisions and the everyday habits that keep systems maintainable.

  • Share in operating what we build, including a sustainable on call rotation for the services and tooling other teams rely on.

Qualities we look for

  • A software engineering background, in any language, with real depth in at least one. We genuinely do not mind which: C#, Go, TypeScript and Python are all well represented here. We care that you can build software other engineers rely on, and that you can read your way into an unfamiliar codebase.

  • Time in a product team, shipping to external customers. The best developer experience work comes from people who have personally felt the pipeline they are now redesigning, and who know what a product team is actually optimising for.

  • Genuine passion for developer experience. Build systems, CI and CD, internal platforms, release engineering, and the texture of what makes a codebase pleasant or miserable to work in. This is a role for someone who finds this intrinsically interesting, not a stepping stone.

  • Enthusiasm for figuring out where AI creates real leverage in how software gets built, a willingness to run experiments that fail, and enough scepticism to tell the difference between a genuine improvement and a demo.

  • A track record of technical ownership spanning several teams. You create clarity where a mandate crosses team boundaries, hold clear positions, change them on evidence, and carry other engineers with you.

  • The judgement to trade the ideal solution for one you can ship and iterate on, and the tenacity to keep going. Changing how an engineering organisation works is a long game, and adoption is the hard part.

You would get bonus points for

  • Measuring developer productivity credibly, through DORA, developer surveys, or your own defensible approach.

  • Having built or operated AI-assisted developer tooling: code review, agents, MCP servers, or evaluation of any of the above.

  • Experience building an internal developer platform or portal, especially with Backstage.

  • Community building you can point to. Open source maintainership, a guild or community of practice, developer advocacy, or any place you have grown adoption and ownership rather than mandated it.

  • GitLab or comparable CI and CD at scale, and build system work on large polyglot codebases. Runner fleets, pipeline performance, caching and artifacts, and compile and test time optimisation.

What we offer

  • Diverse and internationally distributed team: joining our team means becoming part of a large, global community with people of more than 90 nationalities. We're more than just colleagues; we're a group of professionals with a shared mission to connect diverse cultures. Our global presence is growing–we've doubled in size nearly every year, with our employees based in the UK, Germany, the Netherlands, Poland, the US, and Japan, and we continue to expand our network.

  • Open communication, regular feedback: as a language-focused company, we value the importance of clear, honest communication. We value smooth collaboration, direct and actionable feedback, and believe that leading with empathy and growth mindset makes us better together.

  • Hybrid work, flexible hours: we offer a hybrid work schedule, with team members coming into the office twice a week. This allows you to engage directly with your team and experience the unique energy of our workspace, while still enjoying the flexibility and comfort of working from home. With flexible working hours and trust in your productivity, we are in sync with your team’s general locations and time zones to foster effective and seamless collaboration.

  • Virtual Shares - An ownership mindset in every role. We believe everyone should share in our success, and that’s why every employee receives Virtual Shares, linking your contribution directly to DeepL’s growth and rewarding you with a stake in our future.

  • Regular in-person team events: we bond over vibrant events that are as unique as our team, from local team and business unit gatherings, to new-joiner onboardings, to company-wide events that bring us all together–literally.

  • Monthly full-day hacking sessions: every month, we have Hack Fridays, where you can spend your time diving into a project you're passionate about and get the opportunity to work with other teams–we value your initiatives, impact, and creativity.

  • 30 days of annual leave: we value your peace of mind. With 30 days off (excluding public holidays) and access to mental health resources, we make sure you're as strong mentally as you are professionally.

  • Competitive benefits: just as our team spans the globe, so does our benefits package. We've crafted it to reflect the diversity of our team and tailored it to align with your unique location, to ensure you feel supported every step of the way.

If this role and our mission resonate with you, but you're hesitant because you don't check all the boxes, don't let that hold you back. At DeepL, it's all about the value you bring and the growth we can foster together. Go ahead, apply—let's discover your potential together. We can't wait to meet you!

We are an equal opportunity employer

You are welcome at DeepL for who you are - we appreciate authenticity here. Our product is for everyone, and so is our workplace. The more voices we have represented and amplified in our business, the more we will all succeed, contribute, and think forward! So bring us your personal experience, your perspectives, and your background. It’s in our diversity that we will find the power to break down language barriers in the world.

jobs.title: Director of Corporate Development
jobs.description:
About Andercore

Andercore is the AI-native supplier of industrial materials for energy, infrastructure, and construction in wholesale and beyond.

We trade with global suppliers and distribute to European customers on our own account. Our AI runs the full trade and distribution end-to-end: sourcing, quality, pricing, sales, logistics, and embedded financing. For the customer, it feels like buying from their preferred local supplier; for our partners, it is the most convenient and safe way to do business across borders. Behind it, our software and agentic AI do the heavy lifting that used to take an asset-intensive supply chain with four or five intermediaries and weeks of manual coordination.

Where we are today:

  • Strong triple-digit-million euro turnover

  • Seven European markets live

  • 80+ people across Berlin (HQ), offices in London, Mumbai, and Shanghai

$40M Series B just closed, $75M raised to date from Atomico, Project A, and Inven Capital, institutional financing from international banks.

We are building the world's first and last industrial-grade AI operating system for materials, redefining how global trade works in one of the largest and most essential industries on earth.

The Opportunity

This is not a traditional Corporate Development role.

As Director of Corporate Development, you will work directly with the CEO and take responsibility for building Andercore's M&A engine from the ground up. You will help define our roll-up strategy, identify and approach acquisition targets, develop investment cases and execute transactions end-to-end. At the same time, you will work closely with our technology and operating teams to answer the question at the heart of our strategy:

How can we acquire traditional industrial businesses and use technology and AI to make them dramatically better?

This means thinking beyond financial engineering and traditional buy-and-build.

You will help identify where AI, automation, centralized procurement, data, pricing, sales productivity, working-capital optimization and shared infrastructure can fundamentally improve the economics of acquired businesses.

Your mandate is ultimately to build a repeatable acquisition and value-creation machine capable of executing multiple transactions every year.

What You Will Own

M&A & Roll-Up Strategy

  • Take Andercore's acquisition and consolidation strategy across Europe to the next level.

  • Identify attractive verticals, geographies and acquisition archetypes.

  • Build market maps and identify highly fragmented markets suitable for consolidation.

  • Develop the financial and strategic logic behind our roll-up thesis.

  • Determine where Andercore's technology and AI capabilities can create disproportionate value after acquisition.

  • Build a multi-year acquisition roadmap together with the CEO and Board.

Proprietary Deal Origination

  • Build and continuously develop a proprietary pipeline of acquisition opportunities.

  • Identify and directly approach founders and owners of attractive businesses.

  • Build trusted relationships with entrepreneurs, often long before they consider selling.

  • Develop systematic, data-driven sourcing approaches.

  • Build relationships with investment banks, M&A boutiques, advisers and other intermediaries.

We expect proprietary sourcing to become a core competitive advantage of Andercore's M&A strategy.

Deal Execution

Own transactions from first conversation through closing:

  • Initial assessment and strategic fit

  • Financial analysis and valuation

  • Investment cases

  • Deal structuring

  • LOIs

  • Negotiation

  • Commercial, financial, tax and legal due diligence

  • Financing

  • Board and shareholder materials

  • Signing and closing

You will coordinate internal stakeholders and external advisers while remaining personally accountable for moving transactions forward.

AI-Driven Value Creation

Our ambition is not simply to acquire businesses. It is to transform them.

Together with Andercore's technology and operating teams, you will identify opportunities to apply AI, automation and our central platform across areas such as:

  • Sales productivity and customer intelligence

  • Pricing and margin optimization

  • Procurement

  • Supplier management

  • Customer service

  • Finance and administration

  • Working capital

  • Logistics and fulfilment

  • Data and reporting

You will incorporate these opportunities into acquisition theses and quantify their potential impact before we invest.

Integration & Portfolio Value Creation

  • Develop Day-1 and 100-day plans before closing.

  • Translate investment theses into measurable operational initiatives.

  • Define integration priorities together with functional leaders.

  • Track acquisition performance against the original investment case.

  • Identify additional opportunities for technology deployment, synergies and operational improvement.

The objective is not necessarily to integrate everything immediately. It is to determine what should be centralized, what should remain entrepreneurial and where Andercore's platform creates the greatest advantage.

Build the M&A Machine

You will build the infrastructure required to turn acquisitions into a repeatable capability using the latest AI stack:

  • M&A playbook

  • Target database and pipeline

  • Valuation frameworks

  • Investment committee processes

  • Due diligence standards

  • Deal documentation

  • Integration playbooks

  • Portfolio reporting

  • Value-creation tracking

As our acquisition pace increases, you will build and lead a dedicated Corporate Development team.

What We're Looking For

We are looking for an exceptional investor and operator. The strongest candidates will likely come from:

  • Leading Private Equity funds, particularly buy-and-build or mid-market investing

  • Top-tier Investment Banking / M&A

  • Corporate Development at a highly acquisitive company

  • A combination of Investment Banking and Private Equity

You will likely bring 5–10 years of relevant experience, including meaningful exposure to transactions.

Experience in industrial distribution, business services, industrial technology or fragmented-market consolidation is particularly valuable.

You combine:

  • Exceptional financial and analytical capabilities

  • Strong commercial judgment

  • Deep understanding of M&A

  • Excellent negotiation skills

  • Entrepreneurial instinct

  • High ownership and execution intensity

  • Ability to build relationships with entrepreneurs and business owners

  • Intellectual curiosity around AI and technology

You do not need to be an AI engineer.

But you should be deeply interested in understanding how AI changes businesses, cost structures and competitive advantages — and how those changes can create entirely new acquisition strategies.

German and English fluency are highly preferred.

Who You Are

  • You think like an investor but operate like an entrepreneur.

  • You enjoy understanding businesses quickly and identifying what makes them valuable.

  • You are comfortable calling a founder yourself, building the model yourself, negotiating an LOI and presenting the investment case to the Board.

  • You don't need an established process around you. You build the process.

  • You combine analytical rigor with speed and pragmatism.

📣 Activate regional go-to-market initiatives

🌀 Champion partner feedback and continuous improvement

  • Act as the voice of partners internally, sharing insights that shape future programs, incentives, and product priorities.

  • Identify regional challenges and opportunities, and translate them into scalable improvements.

  • Use partner and performance data to improve the partner experience and increase operational efficiency.

  • Contribute to the evolution of n8n’s global partner program based on regional learnings.

  • Help define what excellent SI partnerships look like as n8n continues to scale.

Requirements

Must-haves

  • 🚀 SaaS partnership experience: You have 8+ years of experience in business development, partnerships, alliances, or sales within fast-scaling SaaS or technology companies, including at least 3 years working directly with services partners as a quota-carrying individual contributor.

  • 🏗️ Builder’s mindset: You enjoy creating programs and processes from scratch rather than maintaining static playbooks. You are hands-on, data-driven, and focused on outcomes.

jobs.title: Dev/Ops Platform Engineer (m/w/d)
jobs.description:
Aufgaben

Ihre Aufgaben

  • Cloud Plattform gestalten: Sie bauen eine moderne Azure Cloud und Container Umgebung für geschäftskritische, selbst entwickelte Anwendungen auf und entwickeln diese kontinuierlich weiter
  • Migration vorantreiben: Sie begleiten die Transformation bestehender Docker und On Premises Umgebungen in eine skalierbare und zukunftsfähige Azure Infrastruktur
  • Container orchestrieren: Sie betreiben und optimieren containerisierte Anwendungen und arbeiten dabei mit Technologien wie Docker, Kubernetes und Azure Kubernetes Service
  • Deployments automatisieren: Sie entwickeln und optimieren CI/CD Pipelines und sorgen für automatisierte, zuverlässige und reproduzierbare Deployments
  • Infrastructure as Code etablieren: Sie automatisieren die Bereitstellung und Konfiguration von Infrastruktur, beispielsweise mit Terraform, Bicep oder vergleichbaren Technologien
  • Stabilität sicherstellen: Sie verantworten gemeinsam mit dem Team den zuverlässigen Betrieb der Anwendungen und stellen Verfügbarkeit, Performance und Skalierbarkeit der Plattform sicher
  • Monitoring weiterentwickeln: Sie implementieren technische und fachliche Monitoring Checks, erkennen Störungen frühzeitig und schaffen Transparenz über Performance und Stabilität der Systeme
  • Probleme nachhaltig lösen: Sie analysieren Fehler und Störungen bis auf Infrastruktur und Anwendungsebene und entwickeln gemeinsam mit Entwicklung und Betrieb nachhaltige Lösungen
  • DevOps Kultur leben: Sie arbeiten eng mit Softwareentwicklung, Cloud Engineering und weiteren IT Bereichen zusammen und treiben Automatisierung, Standardisierung und kontinuierliche Verbesserung aktiv voran.

Qualifikation

Ihr Profil

  • DevOps Erfahrung: Sie verfügen über mehrere Jahre Berufserfahrung im DevOps Engineering, Platform Engineering, Cloud Engineering oder einem vergleichbaren Umfeld
  • Azure Expertise: Sie kennen Microsoft Azure sehr gut und haben praktische Erfahrung beim Aufbau oder Betrieb produktiver Cloud Umgebungen
  • Container Know how: Docker gehört zu Ihrem täglichen Werkzeugkasten, idealerweise bringen Sie zusätzlich praktische Erfahrung mit Kubernetes beziehungsweise Azure Kubernetes Service mit
  • CI/CD Kompetenz: Sie haben Erfahrung mit automatisierten Build, Test und Deployment Prozessen sowie dem Aufbau und der Pflege entsprechender Pipelines
  • Automatisierung: Infrastructure as Code ist für Sie kein Fremdwort, Kenntnisse in Terraform, Bicep, Ansible oder vergleichbaren Werkzeugen sind besonders willkommen
  • Monitoring Verständnis: Sie wissen, wie produktive Systeme sinnvoll überwacht werden und haben Erfahrung mit Monitoring, Logging und der Analyse von Performanceproblemen
  • Technisches Verständnis: Grundkenntnisse in SQL, Netzwerken sowie Linux und Windows Infrastrukturen helfen Ihnen dabei, Probleme auch über Systemgrenzen hinweg zu analysieren
  • Entwicklungsnähe: Sie müssen kein Softwareentwickler sein, können sich aber gut in moderne Anwendungsarchitekturen hineinversetzen, Erfahrung im Umfeld von C#, React oder VueJS ist von Vorteil
  • Arbeitsweise: Sie denken analytisch, arbeiten strukturiert und eigenverantwortlich und haben Freude daran, bestehende Lösungen nicht nur zu betreiben, sondern kontinuierlich zu verbessern
  • Kommunikation: Sie verfügen über sehr gute Deutschkenntnisse (mind. C1) sowie gute Englischkenntnisse und arbeiten gerne mit unterschiedlichen technischen Ansprechpartnern zusammen.

Benefits

Das erwartet Sie

  • Technischer Gestaltungsspielraum: Sie arbeiten nicht ausschließlich im klassischen Betrieb, sondern können den Aufbau und die Weiterentwicklung einer modernen Cloud Plattform aktiv mitgestalten
  • Moderne Technologien: Sie bewegen sich in einem technologisch spannenden Umfeld rund um Azure, Container, Kubernetes, CI/CD und Infrastructure as Code
  • Eigene Anwendungen: Statt ausschließlich Standardsoftware zu administrieren, arbeiten Sie an der Infrastruktur für selbst entwickelte und geschäftskritische Anwendungen
  • Hybrides Arbeiten: Sie verbinden die Zusammenarbeit mit dem Team am Standort Dormagen mit flexiblen Möglichkeiten zum mobilen Arbeiten
  • Langfristige Perspektive: Sie erhalten einen unbefristeten Arbeitsvertrag in einem wachsenden und international aufgestellten Unternehmen
  • Entwicklungsmöglichkeiten: Sie können Ihre Kenntnisse rund um Cloud, Plattform Engineering und Automatisierung kontinuierlich ausbauen und eigene Ideen einbringen
  • Attraktive Rahmenbedingungen: Dazu gehören 30 Urlaubstage, transparente Arbeitszeiterfassung, Weiterbildungsangebote, JobRad beziehungsweise Fitnessangebote, Zuschüsse zur betrieblichen Altersvorsorge oder zu vermögenswirksamen Leistungen sowie kostenfreie Parkmöglichkeiten.

Capmo is the digital partner on construction sites, with over 100k projects delivered faster and more successfully with the help of our platform. We are one of the fastest-growing B2B SaaS companies in Europe and stay true to our mission of making hard things in construction feel easy.

Thousands of project managers run their construction sites on Capmo every day — which means our customers trust us with data that is critical to their business. Keeping that trust is the job you'd own.

Help us continue to revolutionize the industry! Find out more about us and come join us in our engineering hubs in Berlin and Munich.

As a Senior Security Engineer at Capmo, you will get to:

  • own product and cloud security end to end — threat modeling, security reviews, secure-by-default patterns, and the tooling in our CI/CD pipelines (SAST, dependency and container scanning, secret detection) that keeps findings from piling up.

  • harden our AWS infrastructure: IAM architecture, network segmentation, encryption, logging, workload security — and encode the baselines as policy-as-code instead of a wiki page nobody reads.

  • build our detection and response capability from the ground up, and be the technical lead when something actually happens — from detection through containment to the post-incident review.

  • own our vulnerability disclosure and pentest programs, and drive remediation with the product teams rather than filing tickets and hoping.

  • back our compliance work (ISO 27001, SOC 2, GDPR) with real technical controls and evidence, and support customer security reviews together with Sales.

  • shape the direction of security at Capmo as a hands-on senior IC — building guardrails that engineers adopt because they're good, not because they're mandated.


What we offer

jobs.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs.description:
Why Faculty?


We established Faculty in 2014 because we thought that AI would be the most important technology of our time. Since then, we’ve worked with over 350 global customers to transform their performance through human-centric AI. You can read about our real-world impact here.

We don’t chase hype cycles. We innovate, build and deploy responsible AI which moves the needle - and we know a thing or two about doing it well. We bring an unparalleled depth of technical, product and delivery expertise to our clients who span government, finance, retail, energy, life sciences and defence.

Our business, and reputation, is growing fast and we’re always on the lookout for individuals who share our intellectual curiosity and desire to build a positive legacy through technology.

AI is an epoch-defining technology, join a company where you’ll be empowered to envision its most powerful applications, and to make them happen.

About the Team

Bringing medicine to patients is complex, expensive and high-risk. Faculty’s Life Science’s team is concentrated on building AI solutions which optimise the research and commercialisation of life-changing therapies.

We partner with major pharma firms, academic research centres and MedTech start-ups to design and deliver solutions which address critical healthcare challenges, and help to democratise health for all.

About the role:

As a Senior Software Engineer, we’ll look to you to lead development and deployment of cutting-edge AI and software systems for our diverse clients. You’ll design, build, and deploy scalable, production-grade ML/software and infrastructure that meets rigorous operational and ethical standards.

This is an ambitious, cross-functional role requiring a blend of technical expertise and confident client-facing skills.

What you'll be doing:

  • Leading technical scoping and architectural decisions for high-impact ML and software systems

  • Designing and building production-grade ML/software, tools, and scalable infrastructure

  • Defining and implementing best practices and standards for deploying machine learning at scale across the business

  • Collaborating with engineers, data scientists, product managers, and commercial teams to solve critical client challenges and leverage opportunities

  • Acting as a trusted technical advisor to customers and partners, translating complex concepts into actionable strategies

  • Mentoring and developing junior engineers, actively shaping our team's engineering culture and technical depth

Who we're looking for:

  • You possess strong software engineering skills in Python and at least one compiled or strongly-typed language (e.g. Go, Java, Rust, or TypeScript), and know how to build robust, production-grade systems.

  • You bring deep expertise in software engineering and strong Python skills, focusing on building robust, reusable systems

  • You have demonstrable hands-on experience with cloud platforms (e.g., AWS, Azure, GCP), including architecture, security, and infrastructure

  • You've extensive experience working with container and orchestration tools such at Docker & Kubernetes to build and manage applications at scale

  • You thrive in fast-paced, high-growth environments, demonstrating ownership and autonomy in driving projects to completion

  • You communicate exceptionally well, confidently guiding both technical teams and senior, non-technical stakeholders

The Interview Process

  1. Talent Team Screen (30 minutes)

  2. Pair Programming Interview (90 minutes)

  3. System Design Interview (90 minutes)

  4. Commercial Interview (60 minutes)

Our Recruitment Ethos

We aim to grow the best team - not the most similar one. We know that diversity of individuals fosters diversity of thought, and that strengthens our principle of seeking truth. And we know from experience that diverse teams deliver better work, relevant to the world in which we live. We’re united by a deep intellectual curiosity and desire to use our abilities for measurable positive impact. We strongly encourage applications from people of all backgrounds, ethnicities, genders, religions and sexual orientations.

Some of our standout benefits:

  • Unlimited Annual Leave Policy

  • Private healthcare and dental

  • Enhanced parental leave

  • Family-Friendly Flexibility & Flexible working

  • Sanctus Coaching

  • Hybrid Working

If you don’t feel you meet all the requirements, but are excited by the role and know you bring some key strengths, please don't hesitate in applying as you might be right for this role, or other roles. We are open to conversations about part-time hours.

A note on AI: we're happy for you to use it for research and interview prep, but please don't use it to generate answers during live interviews. We also use an AI note-taker (Metaview) in interviews so interviewers can stay present (which you can opt out of just let us know,) and every application is reviewed by a human, never decided by AI.

jobs.title: Backend QA Engineer
jobs.description:
This position is listed on behalf of a partner company, who manages all applications and next steps. Our partner is looking for a Backend QA Engineer based in United Kingdom.

Take ownership of quality across a high-traffic, backend-focused platform where reliability and precision are critical.
You’ll combine hands-on manual testing with automation to validate APIs, transaction lifecycles, data, and event-driven services.
The role gives you the opportunity to uncover edge cases and risks beyond what is explicitly defined in specifications.
You’ll work closely with engineers and other stakeholders to ensure robust releases and prevent critical issues from reaching production.
Your work will span REST and gRPC APIs, relational databases, message queues, and distributed backend services.
You’ll also contribute to automated regression coverage using Go and help continuously strengthen the testing approach.
Working fully remotely within a global team, you’ll have meaningful ownership in a fast-growing technology environment.


Accountabilities
  • Analyze business requirements, functional specifications, and user stories to design comprehensive test cases, scenarios, and coverage strategies.
  • Perform end-to-end testing of transaction lifecycles, including initiation, authorization, settlement, reconciliation, and related workflows.
  • Proactively explore the platform to identify edge cases, unexpected behavior, risks, and gaps not covered by existing specifications.
  • Validate data accuracy, integrity, and consistency across services using SQL queries against PostgreSQL and MySQL.
  • Test REST and gRPC APIs using tools such as Postman, grpcurl, or equivalent solutions, validating requests, responses, error handling, and edge cases.
  • Verify event-driven workflows across message brokers such as Kafka, RabbitMQ, and NATS, including retries, failures, ordering, and duplicate-message handling.
  • Write, maintain, and extend automated regression tests in Go, collaborating with developers when additional test coverage or technical support is required.
  • Log, prioritize, track, and manage defects in Jira, providing clear reproduction steps, payloads, logs, and relevant technical context.
  • Execute regression testing following deployments and help ensure releases meet expected quality standards.
  • Contribute to improving QA processes, automation coverage, and overall testing efficiency across the platform.

    • Requirements:

    • 4+ years of professional manual testing experience, with a strong focus on backend services, APIs, and distributed systems.
    • Previous experience testing products in iGaming, fintech, payment gateways, banking, or another transaction-intensive domain.
    • Strong proficiency in writing intermediate SQL queries for validating and investigating data in relational databases.
    • Hands-on experience with API testing tools, particularly Postman, as well as test management platforms such as TestRail or Zephyr.
    • Ability to read Go code and write or extend automated tests in Go; previous automation experience in another programming language is acceptable if you are willing to work with Go.
    • Working knowledge of Docker and the ability to run and test services locally.
    • Solid understanding of Agile/Scrum methodologies and the Software Testing Life Cycle (STLC).
    • Strong analytical and problem-solving abilities, combined with meticulous attention to detail.
    • Experience with microservices architectures and backend systems is highly valuable.
    • Familiarity with CI/CD pipelines, Kubernetes, or observability and monitoring tools is a plus.
    • Experience supporting User Acceptance Testing (UAT) with business stakeholders is an advantage.
    • Existing professional experience with Go and/or Playwright is considered a plus.
    • Strong communication and collaboration skills, with the ability to work effectively with engineering and business teams in a fully remote environment.

      • Benefits:

      • Fully remote work with a globally distributed team.
      • Full-time opportunity within a fast-growing technology environment.
      • The opportunity to help build and scale a B2B platform from the ground up within a newly established technology ecosystem.
      • Collaboration with teammates and technical professionals from around the world.
      • Up to 28 unavailable days per year, in addition to public holidays.
      • Significant ownership and the opportunity to shape quality practices across a high-traffic platform.
      • Exposure to modern backend technologies, distributed systems, APIs, event-driven architectures, and automated testing.
      • An environment where engineering quality, initiative, and proactive problem-solving are highly valued.

jobs.title: Financial Controller
jobs.description:
We’re building the next generation of employee benefits infrastructure.

At Happl, we help global teams design, manage, and scale benefits that actually work for their people by using AI, across flex allowances, benefits, insurance, recognition, and wellbeing, all in one intelligent platform.

Happl is backed by leading investors such as YCombinator, 6Degrees Capital, Haatch, Portage, and more, known for backing leading companies such as Deel, Rippling, Airbnb, Coinbase, Dropbox, and most recently was awarded a place in the UK’s top 100 startups for 2026.

About the role

As Financial Controller at Happl, you’ll own the financial engine of the business — everything from the cash in the bank to the numbers our board and investors use to make decisions runs through you. You’ll run the monthly close, the full revenue cycle, the compliance calendar across two jurisdictions, and our treasury position, and you’ll decide how all of it gets built, systemised, and automated.

This is a hands-on, high-autonomy role with a direct line to leadership. You won’t be managing a process someone else designed — you’ll be deciding what good looks like across revenue, cash, compliance, and reporting, then making it happen. You’ll work closely with the CEO, the board, our investors, and our outsourced bookkeeping, audit, and tax partners, holding all of it to a standard that matches the product we’ve built.

We’re FCA-regulated and YCombinator-backed, having raised $11m to date, and we give global employers a single place to design, deliver, and manage benefits across 160+ countries and 70+ languages — which means the finance function behind the product has to be just as sharp as the product itself. We’re entering our next phase of growth, with an ambitious revenue trajectory and an expanding international footprint, and this role sits at the centre of it.

What you’ll be doing

  • Owning the monthly close on a fixed timetable — management accounts, balance sheet integrity, accruals, prepayments, and the revenue and cost reconciliations that sit behind them

  • Writing the commentary that explains what’s actually happened in the business, not just what the numbers say

  • Producing the monthly investor reporting pack and the financial sections of board materials — ARR and revenue analysis, cash and runway, burn efficiency, unit economics, cohort and retention metrics, and budget versus actual

  • Owning the full revenue cycle — invoicing, collections, aged debt, and revenue recognition across a multi-currency, multi-contract subscription base

  • Leading the rollout of automated billing and revenue recognition tooling, moving us from manual tracking to a system that scales without adding headcount

  • Managing our two legal entities — a US TopCo and a UK operating company — including statutory accounts, audit preparation, intercompany accounting, transfer pricing mechanics, and FX exposure between them

  • Owning the compliance calendar end to end across both jurisdictions — UK VAT returns, corporation tax, US federal and state filings, sales tax where applicable, and payroll taxes

  • Supporting our FCA regulatory reporting obligations and the financial controls that sit behind them

  • Running monthly payroll across jurisdictions, pension and benefits administration, employee expenses, and the finance side of onboarding and offboarding

  • Owning the cash position and treasury strategy — cash flow forecasting, working capital, FX management, and structuring how we hold company funds to earn a sensible return without taking risk we shouldn’t

  • Managing our outsourced bookkeeping, accounting, and tax partners — holding them to deadlines and quality, and pulling work in-house where doing so makes us faster

  • Owning the finance tech stack and having a strong opinion on it, actively replacing manual work with automation and AI-assisted workflows across reconciliations, invoice processing, variance analysis, and reporting drafts

  • Leveraging AI tools like Claude and ChatGPT to speed up your own work and build the systems that let finance scale without adding headcount

  • Acting as the financial conscience of the business, with a direct line to the founders and a real say in how we grow

What we’re looking for

  • Qualified accountant (ACA, ACCA or CIMA), or qualified by experience with a track record that stands up to scrutiny

  • Genuine ownership of a monthly close cycle and management reporting pack, start to finish

  • Advanced Excel and financial modelling — you build statement models, scenario and sensitivity analysis, and reporting that holds up under investor questioning

  • Strong technical grounding in revenue recognition, accruals accounting, and balance sheet control

  • Comfortable with tax and compliance across VAT, corporation tax, and payroll, ideally spanning both the UK and US

  • AI-native in your approach — you already use AI tools in your day-to-day work and can talk specifically about what you’ve automated and what it saved you

  • Exceptional attention to detail, alongside the judgement to know when precision matters and when speed does

  • A clear communicator — you can explain a number to a non-finance audience without patronising them or losing them

You’ll own the whole picture — revenue, cash, compliance, treasury, and reporting — across two jurisdictions and 160+ countries of operations, with a direct line to the founders and reporting that goes straight to the board and our investors.
